articleTitle: Multiple Optimization Methods of Automatic Application in Last-mile Delivery System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The last mile delivery as the significant realized step of parcel reaching to the customer in the supply chain system. As the e-commerce and pandemic affections, the parcel volumes bring hard time for the current freight system. Thus, the alternative delivery methods combine with truck and robotics proposed a feasible solution for the transportation industry. This article is a literature review about the delivery robot’s applications operation methods. Firstly, the significance of robot in the last mile delivery is analyzed. Secondly, the basic operation and delivery methods of the robot are introduced from the ground layer and three-dimensional space respectively. Then the existing robot control application operation and network design models are analyzed. Finally, based on the operational methods and models, this paper analyzes and summarizes the limitations of the last kilometer delivery system, and its future development is prospected.

articleTitle: Analysis of Power Communication Network And Power Information Security Based on Data Mining Algorithm Under Edge Collaboration Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the proposal of “internet plus” and the penetration of Internet technology in all fields of society, the importance of communication information network security has become increasingly prominent. Communication information data dissemination has brought unprecedented new challenges and problems to national security and social stability. According to the isolation and authentication requirements of information security protection of power grid enterprises, based on the research of the relevant smart grid business scenarios, system architecture and security requirements with wireless public network as the channel, the monitoring architecture of wireless public network channel for intelligent power distribution is designed, including the monitoring scheme of intelligent power distribution business terminal, system master station, wireless public network channel and other links. In order to ensure the safe and reliable operation of power communication access network, encryption, authentication, isolation and other security protection measures are mainly adopted. Another important index to measure the network performance of power communication network is the quality of service ($Q_{0}$S), which will be sacrificed at the cost of network security. This paper proposes a method of information system security situation assessment based on DM. Situation assessment is one of the most important measures to detect the security of information systems, which can provide power system security status information for managers. Managers can obtain the abnormal problems in the system and take targeted measures to improve the security performance of the system.

articleTitle: Construction of Power Equipment Running Status Monitoring System Based on Infrared Temperature Measurement Technology and Big Data Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: At present, with the rapid growth of power demand every year and the commercial operation of power enterprises, the health status and maintenance cost of power transmission and transformation equipment directly affect the reliability of equipment operation, enterprise benefits and market competitiveness. In this paper, the construction of power equipment running status monitoring system based on infrared temperature measurement technology and big data algorithm is launched. In the design scheme of this system, the infrared thermal imager is used as the acquisition core, the high-performance industrial computer is used as the processing core, and the network communication technology based on TCP/IP protocol is used to form a powerful and easy-to-operate power transformer running status monitoring system. A selective oversampling mechanism and an integrated classifier updating algorithm with central nodes are designed to improve the accuracy of the model in identifying small-class samples. The research results show that the mining error rate of this method has dropped to 8% after 800s learning. The running time of optimized feature extraction is only about 32% of that of standard platform. The data stream is classified by mining local nodes and central nodes.

articleTitle: Research on Design and Application of Data Transmission Monitoring System in Thermal Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In the daily analysis and statistical work of thermal power plants, the real-time or historical data of data transmission monitoring system can not only reflect the real-time operating state and historical operating conditions of units, systems and equipment, but also provide production index statistics, performance calculation and economic analysis, equipment reliability monitoring and statistics. From the control level, the data transmission monitoring system collects the operation parameters and state information of the whole plant equipment, which is beneficial for the management of the power plant to monitor the operation state of the unit. In this paper, the data transmission monitoring system of thermal power plant is designed, and the application of the system is discussed. This system collects the processed signals, and this paper uses three algorithms to test. The results show that the accuracy of the traditional system is obviously lower than that of this system, and the highest accuracy of this system can reach 91.23%. This experiment confirms the correctness of this system. The data transmission monitoring system involved in this paper has obvious application advantages in safety and reliability, and promoting the integrated application of control management is of fundamental significance to the improvement of economic benefits of thermal power plants.

articleTitle: Lightweight Network Security Protection Strategy for Power IoT in Micro-Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet of Things (IoT) technology, the range of equipment control based on remote network is expanding. Because the open network environment is faced with various types of attack risks, some cryptographic techniques have been used to perform terminal access verification and have achieved good results. However, traditional security authentication methods have high resource requirements in storage, computing, and processing, and are difficult to adapt to resource-constrained household IoT devices. In view of the above problems, this paper proposes a lightweight security authentication scheme to improve the security of remote access of IoT devices. This scheme can not only effectively prevent replay attacks, server spoofing, man-in-the-middle attacks and other forms of risk, but also ensure the confidentiality and authenticity of users and devices. The implementation results show that the performance of the proposed scheme in terms of network delay, throughput and energy consumption can meet the requirements of practical performance.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Smart Stadium System Based on Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Sports venues are professional sports venues for athletes to carry out sports training and sports competitions. Optimizing the management of sports venues plays an important role in the development of sports. At present, the utilization rate of sports venues in sports bureau is not high, and the operational benefits are not obvious.Therefore, an efficient and intelligent intelligent gymnasium system based on Internet technology is designed and developed to improve the utilization rate and management level of gymnasium venues. The reservation system of stadiums and gymnasiums is realized by ASP.NET technology and B/S structure. Intelligent stadium system includes intelligent security monitoring system, intelligent temperature and humidity management system, intelligent lighting system, intelligent ticketing system, sports data collection system, intelligent sports knowledge system and business data display system. Using IoT technology to collect and analyze data through the camera, the 24-hour security monitoring of sports venues is realized. The system greatly improves the efficiency of stadium management and meets the needs of information management.

articleTitle: Research on Anomaly Detection Algorithm of Chemical Storage Tanks Based on FCM-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: How to accurately detect the abnormal state of chemical storage tanks is the core problem of industrial control system, and real-time detection of abnormal changes of chemical storage tanks is very important for safety production management. However, traditional anomaly detection models are often based on content characteristics, and the accuracy of unsupervised learning is insufficient. Supervised learning requires a large number of learning samples. Therefore, in order to improve the accuracy of anomaly detection, this paper proposes an anomaly detection method for chemical storage tanks based on FCM-LSTM (fuzzy c-means optimization of long-term and short-term memory neural networks). This method establishes a framework for feature extraction, anomaly detection, pattern recognition and prediction analysis of chemical storage tank level, and can be used in anomaly detection of related businesses. Finally, the simulation experiment of abnormal detection of chemical storage tanks is verified and analyzed. After simulating the collected data of chemical storage tanks, the results show that the detection accuracy of this algorithm can reach 95.87%, which is 10.08% higher than that of PSO algorithm. Moreover, the detection error of this algorithm is small, and it can be completely used in the abnormal detection of chemical storage tanks. It provides a new idea and reference for abnormal detection of chemical storage tanks.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Algorithm of Public Network Attack Data Mining Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent years, according to the data released by the national Internet Information Center, cyber attacks have become an upward trend, which has brought great potential threats to users, and even caused incalculable losses to many users. In order that users can use the network more safely and avoid users from network attacks, the research of detecting network attacks has become very important and urgent. Aiming at the problem that the prediction accuracy of existing network attack detection methods is not high, the intelligent algorithm of public network attack data mining based on deep neural network is studied. The openness and self-organization of public network make the network vulnerable to virus interference and intrusion attacks. Accurate and efficient mining of attack data can ensure network security; Traditional methods use time-frequency directional beam feature clustering method to realize attack data mining. When the signal-to-noise ratio is low, the probability of accurate attack data mining is low. The existing network attack detection methods include static detection and dynamic detection, but both of them have some shortcomings, rely too much on rules, and have the problem of high false positive rate. Aiming at the shortcomings of traditional network attack detection, this paper introduces deep neural network technology into the field of public network attack detection. According to the characteristics of data mining technology and attack detection, this paper applies data mining technology to public network attack detection system. Make the system have the ability of self-learning and predict the impact of the overall attack scheme on the attacked public network.

articleTitle: Research on Transparent Access Technology of Data Resources Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data, data has become an intangible asset with great social and economic value. Access control technology is an important means to limit the access range of users to data and effectively ensure the safe access of data by formulating relevant policies. Data resource transaction is an important means to give full play to the value of service data resources. However, at present, the domestic service data resource transaction market is not as prosperous as expected. The unique attributes of service data resources make it difficult to be quantitatively analyzed, and it is also prone to theft and leakage. Therefore, the transaction of service data resources urgently needs a new safe and reliable transaction system. In view of this situation, a transparent access scheme of heterogeneous data resources based on Web Services is proposed, and the system architecture and key technologies in implementation are given. This paper formulates the corresponding access control strategy according to the attributes of Web data flow elements, and proposes an improved multi-pattern matching algorithm AC_ BMH_ QS, and apply the algorithm to the access control policy matching process, improve the shortcomings of the original policy matching method, and better realize the fast and real-time access control decision under multi-policy conditions.

articleTitle: Time Series Database Optimization Based on InfluxDB
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The performance issues of InfluxDB’s TSM (Time-Structured Merge) storage engine, which is based on the LSMTree architecture, have been addressed in this paper. The focus is on eliminating write stalls, reducing write amplification, and optimizing resource utilization in scenarios with continuous longterm writes. An optimization design and implementation have been presented for InfluxDB to achieve these objectives. Moreover, to further enhance the modifications made to InfluxDB’s TSM storage engine, a compute-storage separated cluster architecture has been introduced and implemented. The objective is to tackle the native clustering solution’s lack of scalability. Experimental results demonstrate that the transformations applied to the InfluxDB storage engine in this paper have successfully achieved the design objectives, leading to improved write performance.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Distribution Network Short Circuit Fault Location Algorithm Based on DTU and FPI
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Accurate and rapid location of short-circuit fault in distribution network is of great significance to improve the reliability of power supply in distribution network. At present, the short-circuit fault location of distribution management system (DMS) main station requires high data quality of line terminals, and there are problems such as poor fault tolerance and low accuracy of fault location, and it is not suitable for fault location of multi-point simultaneous short circuit. In this article, the short-circuit fault detection technology of DMS based on wavelet algorithm is proposed, and the fault current is detected and fault location is carried out by using the cooperation of Distribution Terminal Unit (DTU) and Fault Passage Indicators (FPI), which integrates fault detection and fault location. The experimental data and analysis results show the effectiveness of this method. With the help of wide-area synchronous measurement information, this method realizes the detection and location of two fault points of two-phase grounding short circuit. Moreover, this method can detect whether single-phase overcurrent occurs and the location of overcurrent in other lines when a single-phase grounding fault occurs, so as to achieve the goal of detecting and locating the weak point of equipment insulation, which provides technical support for improving the reliability of lines.

articleTitle: Power System Optimal Dispatch and Transaction Model Considering Renewable Energy Output and Electricity Price Volatility
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the optimization problem of large-scale renewable energy grid-connected power generation, a scheduling optimization transaction model considering renewable energy output and electricity price fluctuation is proposed. The basic requirements and strategies of renewable energy grid-connected power generation at the present stage are analyzed, and an optimization model aiming at the minimum cost is established for the fluctuation of renewable energy output and electricity price, considering gas turbines, battery energy storage, wind power as the operational constraints of photovoltaic and other units. An optimized transaction model based on the database is established, and the KNN algorithm is used for analysis. Finally, combined with the actual engineering, the application analysis of the model proposed in this paper is carried out, and the validity of the proposed model is illustrated.

articleTitle: Construction of Direct Current Power Metering and Power Quality Detection System Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In industrial production, DC (Direct Current) large current is often used in large aluminum electrolysis plants, coating plants, electric vehicle charging and discharging and other fields. With the development of society, these industrial DC power consumption is increasing, and the DC current level is getting higher and higher. Although there are many different views on the definition and interpretation of power quality, there are still great differences on the causes of DC flow measurement and power quality deterioration. The DC flow measurement and power quality are effectively monitored and analyzed, and almost all power quality parameters in the power grid, including system power supply frequency, are monitored online in real time. Monitor the negative sequence pollution of the substation or users in real time, and find out the hidden danger endangering the generator and relay protection in time. The power quality detection system is built through PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization). By analyzing a large number of power quality disturbance data obtained by the system, not only can various information reflecting the power quality of the distribution system be directly obtained, but also can provide theoretical guidance for the next step to adopt various measures to improve power quality.

articleTitle: Research on Algorithm of Land Engineering Survey Technology Based on Computer Big Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The improvement of land engineering survey technology based on computer big data is closely related to the technical development. With the rapid development of computer information technology, the application of computer big data technology in land engineering survey technology has become a norm. The dependence of land engineering survey technology on data and computer information technology determines that it must keep pace with the times in the wave of computer information technology information age, constantly innovate its own technical level, rely on advanced technology for data collection and effective application, so as to make it play a greater role in China's land resource management and development. At the national level, the development of computer information technology and big data has become a strategic choice to enhance competitiveness; At the economic level, the development of big data has become a key factor in building new momentum. Based on the specific practice of applying computer big data technology to land engineering measurement technology, this paper will help to further improve the accuracy and efficiency of land engineering measurement technology, and is more conducive to the significant reduction of measurement cost, so that the land engineering measurement technology under the big data of computer information technology will enter a new stage.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Layout of Sensors in Civil Engineering Structure Based on Association Rule Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent years, China’s construction industry has experienced a period of rapid development. It is one of the pillar industries of China’s national economy and has a profound impact on China’s macro-economy. However, engineering is a dynamic process, which has the characteristics of long construction period, intensive capital, many participants, complex structure and high risk, which leads to huge resource consumption and low efficiency in the construction industry. With the development of civil engineering technology in China, relevant personnel need to pay active attention to the research of sensor principle and the use of sensors in smart material structures, and promote the economic progress of China by improving the application effect of sensors. Intelligent structure of civil engineering is an engineering structure with functions of sensing, control and driving, among which the functions and characteristics of sensing elements are very important. In this paper, the intelligent structure of civil engineering is summarized, the principle and application of sensors in the intelligent structure of civil engineering are analyzed in detail with BIM technology, and an optimal arrangement method of sensors in civil engineering structure based on association rule mining algorithm is proposed.

articleTitle: Construction of Distribution Network Fault Detection Model Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of power grid system, China has built the largest and most complex power grid system in the world. How to ensure the stability of power supply and find and solve power grid faults in time has become the main problem to be solved urgently. In this paper, a new fault detection model of distribution network is constructed based on AI (Artificial intelligence) algorithm in order to diagnose power network faults effectively and timely. Based on the principle of system energy conservation, the model takes the arc suppression coil as a branch to participate in the analysis of fault lines, avoiding the limitation of only using transient energy of fault branches and non-fault branches to select lines, and improving the accuracy of line selection. The simulation results show that the error of this algorithm is reduced by about 10.12% compared with the traditional method. The algorithm avoids the generation of infeasible solutions, is easy to be combined with various intelligent algorithms, and improves the efficiency of optimization. Compared with the traditional NN algorithm, the fault detection model of distribution network has obvious advantages in performance, which can give early warning of faults in time and greatly improve the efficiency of fault diagnosis of power network. Thus, the reliability and economy of the distribution network are further improved.

articleTitle: Simulation of Public Opinion Early Warning Model of Mobile Social Network Based on Big Data Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The spread of public opinion in mobile social networks needs the active guidance and control of the state. If public opinion cannot be effectively managed in a timely and accurate manner, it will inevitably have an adverse impact on the stability of the country and society. In this paper, the public opinion early warning model of mobile social network based on big data algorithm is proposed, which automatically crawls online comment data through web crawler, preprocesses it and stores it in the database. On the basis of constructing a social emotion dictionary, the automatic classification of social emotions is realized by combining various text classification algorithms, and the classification results are visualized. The simulation results show that the social sentiment analysis method of hot events based on text big data algorithm has achieved ideal experimental results, which proves the effectiveness of the social sentiment analysis model and method in this paper. With the development of public opinion, the trend of public opinion will continue to fluctuate. The media and the government should pay attention to the overall control of public opinion and take effective measures at the appropriate time to prevent the trend of public opinion from appearing huge ups and downs.

articleTitle: Simulation of Vehicle Scheduling Model for Internet of Things Distribution Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Meeting customers’ requirements is an important criterion to measure the reputation of logistics enterprises. Therefore, how to reasonably optimize IoT (Internet of things) delivery vehicle scheduling while meeting customers’ requirements has always been a problem in the field of logistics optimization. In order to obtain a more ideal vehicle scheduling scheme for IoT distribution, this paper proposes a vehicle scheduling model for IoT distribution based on PSO (Particle swarm optimization) algorithm. Aiming at the deficiency of standard PSO algorithm, this paper improves PSO algorithm by using hybrid algorithm. On the premise of doing a lot of research on solving the optimal scheduling problem of IoT delivery vehicles, the replication and migration operators in the bacterial colony algorithm are added. By improving the algorithm, the optimal scheduling problem of IoT delivery vehicles proposed in this paper is solved. The simulation results show that the improved PSO algorithm has the ability of fast convergence while maintaining good global search ability, and it is superior to other intelligent algorithms in solving vehicle scheduling problems, and can ensure the timeliness requirements of IoT distribution vehicle optimization scheduling problems.

articleTitle: Research on Chemical Weak Signal Detection Based on Stochastic Resonance Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The role of SR (Statistical Resonance) has always attracted scientists’ interest, especially in the selection of system model and signal detection. The research of SR phenomenon has penetrated into all fields of science, and its technical application is also under active research and development. When the chemical signal is particularly weak, sometimes the introduction of external noise will cause the lag of the detection signal. In this paper, we try to detect chemical weak signals based on SR algorithm. The experimental results show that the signal-to-noise ratio of small parameter signals and large parameter signals with random common frequency increases by 14.5db and 17.4db respectively. It shows that SR algorithm combined with signal compression and subsampling can quickly and effectively detect the large-parameter multi-frequency periodic components submerged in strong noise. In this paper, SR algorithm is used to adaptively adjust the system parameters of SR system in order to optimize the signal-to-noise ratio of SR output signal. It not only overcomes the lag phenomenon of weak chemical signals, but also has good adaptability to signals with different noise levels.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of the Method Based on WOA-ELM and Circular Decision
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this paper, WOA-ELM model and cyclic decision model are used to analyze and model the practical application. First of all, this paper establishes a quantitative trading model, and uses the WOA-ELM model to establish the corresponding forecasting model. Through this model, we predict the specific values for the period from September 10, 2016 to September 11, 2021. The optimal position ratio is determined and the periodic decision-making model is established. The optimal investment decision model is established by using Python. The model has high accuracy. The forecast price is not much different from the actual price.

articleTitle: Power Load Forecasting Based on BP Neural Network Optimized by New Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The instability and low accuracy of short-term forecasting of electric power loads, this study deliberately proposes a new improved genetic algorithm through continuous rehearsal. In turn, the accuracy of forecasting model of BP neural network can be improved. It improves the BP neural network's weight initialization, smoothing factor and thresholds, increasing adaptive learning rate and additional momentum of BP neural network, improving the efficiency of searching. Due to the defects of genetic algorithm which is precocious and frequent traps in local optimal solutions, we improve the selection/crossover and mutation operators. Next, we verify the effectiveness of the (Im-GA) -BP model, the power load data of an area were used for training and forecasting, and the improved (Im-GA)-BP model, BP model and actual load were compared. The final data for the relative error of the improved model is reduced by 6.18% and the root mean square error is 5.11 % lower than before. Therefore, the method has a higher prediction accuracy compared to the general BP algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Semantic Classification of Shan shui Images Based on Enhanced Image Processing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: If we can automatically analyze the semantic categories of Shan shui works and realize the automatic classification of Shan shui works, it will play a very effective auxiliary role in the construction of the painting works museum. Therefore, this paper discusses the automatic classification of Shan shui image semantics based on enhanced image processing algorithm. The extraction and representation of visual features of images in the process of image classification is a prerequisite and foundation for the entire process. In the process of information retrieval and extraction that highlights low-level visual features, great attention should also be paid to image performance. The research shows that in the problem of Shan shui image classification, because of the high semantic discrimination of color information, the overall image classification performance decreases significantly after the loss of color information representation; While purely based on global color histogram features, although the representation of color information is strengthened, the classification performance of the algorithm proposed in this chapter is not as good as that of the algorithm in this chapter because of the high discrimination of texture features between Shan shui images and other categories.

articleTitle: Research on a High-precision Indoor Positioning Algorithm based on UWB
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the shift of social change from a single dimension to multiple dimensions, people have also put forward higher requirements for the quality of navigation and positioning services. How to improve the quality of navigation and positioning services and meet people’s growing technological needs has become a major issue of concern for all sectors of society. Due to the small coverage distance indoors and the susceptibility to environmental changes, it is also prone to varying degrees of obstruction, and the closing or movement of indoor doors, furniture, and other objects can also have a certain impact on the signal. Therefore, this article attempts to conduct further research on high-precision indoor positioning algorithms based on UWB. The results show that the Root-mean-square deviation of UWB is relatively unstable, the maximum is 35 cm, and the minimum is 19 cm. The positioning effect of INS is significantly better than that of UWB, but there is still some deviation compared to the real trajectory. And over time, the degree of deviation between INS and the actual trajectory gradually increases. The trajectory effect of the UWB-INS combined positioning system is significantly better than that of a single positioning system, with a positioning accuracy of about 14cm. The long-term positioning effect is more stable and closer to the real trajectory.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Anomaly Detection System of Electric Power Marketing Data Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The performance of the database system reflects the availability and vitality of the database. The database system will have some performance problems after running for a period of time, mainly involving applications, operating systems, database parameters, physical hardware, etc. The database performance optimization is to analyze and adjust the above aspects. The ultimate goal is to solve the system bottleneck, save hardware costs, improve the stability and availability of the database, and then ensure the stable and efficient operation of the business system. The operation performance of the database is adjusted and optimized to achieve the best system performance, which is in line with the practical work of the current information system. In this paper, an optimization design scheme of abnormal detection system for electric power marketing data based on ACA (Ant colony algorithm) is proposed. The abnormal data is systematically summarized by regression analysis, and the execution time of the system is optimized by ACA. Finally, the simulation test analysis is carried out. The simulation results show that the arithmetic has a certain accuracy, which is 7.34% higher than the traditional arithmetic. Through database optimization, the overall business processing capacity is greatly improved, and the work efficiency is improved. Quick marketing services will help enhance customers’ social perception and recognition of smart grid, promote corporate culture and shape the brand image of “National Grid”.

articleTitle: Simulation of Large-Scale 5G Communication Optimization Model Based on Fuzzy Neural Network Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet of Things (IoT) technology, the demand for machine communication (MTC) is increasing. The traditional cellular mobile communication system designed and built for human communication (HTC) will not meet the communication needs of MTC. At the same time, due to the huge number of users and the expanded network scale, the energy consumption of wireless communication network system is on the rise. The environmental pollution caused by greenhouse gas emissions generated by wireless communication systems and the accompanying huge energy consumption have attracted wide attention of operators and the whole society. This article briefly introduces the development of 5G wireless communication systems, comprehensively summarizes the spectrum allocation of millimeter waves, channel propagation characteristics, channel measurement methods, channel detectors, channel parameter estimation algorithms, channel modeling methods, and standardized channel models. A large number of multi band and multi scene millimeter wave channel measurements have been conducted. Experiments were conducted using UCI datasets and engineering examples, and compared with traditional cloud models, fuzzy neural networks, and BP neural networks to analyze the operational efficiency, accuracy, and number of rules of the algorithm. In addition, computer simulation further verifies that the proposed method can achieve better performance compared to several existing codebook design methods.

articleTitle: Research on Control and Optimization of Robot’s Bottom Action Based on PID Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The smooth and safe movement of the robot in the environment is the basis of its various operations. Optimal control is a special branch of modern control methods, which requires not only the stability of the system, but also the realization of the optimal performance index. In this article, an immune feedback PID control based on reinforcement learning is proposed, which not only inherits the advantages of traditional PID control, such as independent of object model, simple control structure, high reliability and easy engineering implementation, but also overcomes the shortcomings of traditional PID controller, such as poor adjustment and follow-up when it has strong interference or high nonlinearity and uncertainty, and greatly improves the performance of the controller. The simulation results show that the robot trajectory control accuracy of the proposed algorithm is higher, and the mean and variance of the deviation between the end effector and the theoretical trajectory are smaller. The fuzzy control system proposed in this article has strong robustness and plays a good role in the control and optimization of the robot’s bottom action.

articleTitle: Security Situation Assessment Model of Big Data Network Based on K-means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: At present, network information acquisition, communication, business transactions and other application fields are used more and more frequently. The ensuing security problems are also emerging one after another. Internet safty has become an important factor affecting social stability, but there are still some drawbacks in the previous internet safty situation assessment technology. In order to solve the existing problems, this article studies the processing and prediction methods of data sources in internet safty situation awareness, and selects multiple data sources as sensing elements to process and predict respectively and strengthen protection; Then the security situation assessment model of big data network based on improved $K -$means clustering algorithm is proposed and constructed. Using this model to assess and predict the internet safty situation, the potential threats can be assessd according to the current attack scenarios, and the real-time network attacks have obvious situation changes. The simulation results show that the evaluation accuracy of this internet safty situation assessment model can reach more than 94%, which is about 8.54% higher than that of the traditional $K -$means method, and the algorithm has high real-time performance. This model provides a new idea for internet safty situation assessment in the field of big data.

articleTitle: Design of Steam Thermal Deicing Control System for Wind Turbine Blades Based on BP Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the growth of wind power industry and the increase of single unit capacity, wind power generation plays a more important role in the national economy, which also puts forward higher requirements for the reliable and stable operation of wind turbines in complex natural environment. Ice coating on the blade surface will change its cross-sectional shape and structure, so that its inherent aerodynamic characteristics will be changed and its aerodynamic performance will be reduced. The increased ice weight will change the natural frequency of the fan parts, which may lead to the stall of the fan blades ahead of time or later, resulting in the loss of wind power generation. Compared with other anti-icing technologies, the blade gas heating method has the engineering and technical advantages of easy transformation, easy maintenance, high deicing efficiency, flexible design and operation. In this article, a back propagation neural network (BPNN) based control algorithm for wind turbine blade thermal de-icing is proposed. This method is used to establish the model of wind turbine, which only needs the data of input and output training samples, and does not need the inherent parameters of the fan and the calculation and derivation process, thus making the modeling and simulation process simpler and more accurate.

articleTitle: Simulation of Compound Forecasting Models of Network Safe Situation Based on Grey Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: At present, the network has become an indispensable part of the information society, and all kinds of institutions rely on the network for their daily work and management. At the same time, all kinds of KIS threats frequently appear, causing very serious threats. KIS technology has developed from traditional intrusion prevention and intrusion detection to intrusion tolerance and survivability research, from focusing on the confidentiality of information to focusing on the availability of information and the sustainability of services, from focusing on solving a single security problem to studying the security state and its changing trend of the whole network. Situation awareness can comprehensively grasp the current security status of the network from a macro level and overall perspective, identify potential security hazards, and speculate and estimate the future security status of the network, providing reliable reference for network managers to formulate countermeasures in a timely manner. This paper proposes a safe situation awareness prediction method based on gray clustering algorithm, and establishes a safe situation forecasting models using improved GM (1, N) theory. Through the collection of abnormal traffic in the campus network and the correlation analysis of security data, it can provide early warning and prompt for potential threats to system security. Finally, the performance of this method is compared.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling of Power Equipment Operation and Maintenance Based on Event Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: A power equipment quality integrated management system based on picture, event knowledge, network and information are established. A top-down domain knowledge graph based on graph database is constructed to meet the actual requirements of power grid equipment quality assessment based on the data storage and dissemination mechanism of graph database. Therefore, it is possible to store multi-source heterogeneous data in graph database effectively. A knowledge graph small sample training and fault prediction method combining the influence factors of equipment faults and historical operating data is proposed based on the gradient lifting decision tree. Through the actual operation test of the substation equipment operation and maintenance processing system, it is found that the system can better promote the substation equipment operation and maintenance method based on event knowledge graph.

articleTitle: Prediction and Simulation Design of Cutting Force of Machine Tool Based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The cutting process is a dynamic stochastic process, which is jointly affected by variable and time-varying cutting conditions and quantifiable and difficult to quantify and predict influencing factors. This article uses fuzzy clustering algorithm to predict and model cutting force. To overcome the shortcomings of FCM (fuzzy c-means) algorithm and improve clustering quality, a new fuzzy clustering algorithm is proposed using PSO (Particle swarm optimization) and FCM algorithm to achieve better prediction of cutting force Firstly, by choosing a reasonable particle initialization space, the sensitivity to the initial clustering center is reduced and the convergence speed is improved. Secondly, by optimizing the maximum velocity of parameter particle motion and introducing the neighborhood of ring topology structure, the defect of premature convergence of PSO algorithm is solved. The simulation results show that the error between experimental data and predicted data is basically in an acceptable range, and the prediction trend is getting better and better, and the predicted results can also meet the measured values in actual cutting. The experimental results prove the effectiveness of FCM in cutting force prediction of CNC machine tools. It is also of great significance for energy-saving machining and process optimization of CNC machine tools.

articleTitle: Analysis and Prospect of Existing UAV Path Planning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Now, UAV technology has become an indispensable means for human exploration and transportation, many transportation and exploration require UAVs to go to designated places. When the UAV is in the outdoor unknown environment, how to avoid obstacles quickly and accurately. This has become the most critical issue. Through the UAV path planning algorithm, the reaction ability of robots to avoid obstacles needs to be improved, so that the robot can reach the destination faster and more stably. As the key technology of UAV, the importance of path planning is self-evident. The premise of researching UAV path planning is the proficiency and application of algorithms. Now many scholars have studied this problem and proposed a large number of algorithms. Through the improvement of the algorithm, UAVs can easily face increasingly complex tasks. This paper summarizes the existing path planning algorithms of UAV from three aspects: bionic intelligence, local path planning and random intelligent algorithms, and analyzes their advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: Construction of Enterprise Intelligent Financial Decision Support System Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In the environment of informatization and data mining, the means of financial fraud are more concealed, and various financial problems are hidden in the massive data. At present, the financial analysis of many enterprises uses some financial indicators to reflect the operation of the enterprise, and only uses charts to describe and display the financial data. The strategic goal of data mining technology is not to master huge and complex data information, but to use specialized technology to analyze and process these data, and realize the value-added of data through analysis and processing. These technologies provide strong support for the innovation of financial analysis and accounting information systems. It uses information technology mining technology to extract useful information and information that people do not know in advance from massive data, and applies theories and methods of computer science, management science and related disciplines. At present, enterprise intelligence has been widely used in machine recognition, fingerprint recognition, iris recognition, palmprint recognition and automatic programming, which has played a great role in promoting the development of human civilization. It can help the financial personnel quickly understand the overall situation of the financial unit, gain insight into the associations and rules in the data, and provide financial clues for the financial personnel. The design goal and realization function of intelligent financial analysis system, the system function module structure is designed, the architecture model of intelligent financial analysis system is constructed, and the design of multidimensional data warehouse and knowledge base are studied. This paper mainly aims at data mining and other technologies to analyze and process a large number of data and information, realize the transformation from data to information, and provide effective support for enterprise intelligent financial decision-making.

articleTitle: Design of Wind Power Grid Connected Energy Storage Cluster Control Algorithm based on Virtual Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As the installed capacity continues to increase, the penetration rate of wind power continues to increase, and its strong volatility and high uncertainty have an increasing impact on the adequacy and safety stability of power supply in the power system. Therefore, the potential issues of grid voltage quality degradation, system inertia loss, and frequency stability reduction that may arise after large-scale wind power integration have increasingly become important factors limiting the development of wind power. In this regard, this article designs a control algorithm for wind power grid connected energy storage clusters based on virtual simulation. The final experimental results show that when the Unit cost of energy storage decreases, the energy storage configuration can be increased as the main force of frequency modulation, and the reserve capacity of wind power can be appropriately reduced; When the cost of energy storage capacity increases, the wind power becomes the main force of frequency regulation due to a high proportion of reserve, and the capacity configuration is appropriately reduced at this time. So, reflecting the spatial and environmental changes of objects in a real form is based on simulation and simulation, so simulation technology can also achieve and predict the movement and changes of things in the actual environment based on the simulation environment.

articleTitle: Research on User Profile and Personalized Recommendation Based on Collaborative Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Due to the rapid development of information technology, fundamental changes have taken place in the way of information production and dissemination, resulting in an increasingly dense information environment for people. In response to the above problems, a personalized recommendation system for immovable cultural relics based on user portraits is planned to be developed. This system can not only make full use of the problems of digital technology, but also reduce the time for users to find information and help users to discover new hobbies. Aiming at the problems of difficult item feature extraction and low degree of personalization in the content-based recommendation algorithm, and the problem of data sparseness and cold start in the collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm, according to the specific requirements of the recommendation scenario, the collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm is mainly adopted, and the content-based recommendation algorithm is mainly based on the collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm. The hybrid recommendation algorithm supplemented by the recommendation algorithm realizes the personalized recommendation function. At the same time, in order to improve system performance and alleviate the problem of cold start, the popular recommendation algorithm is specially adopted. This algorithm extracts the data of registered users in the database, comprehensively analyzes and counts high-frequency information, and recommends it to users after screening.

articleTitle: Realization of Electric Control System in Thermal Power Plant Based on Fuzzy Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The control modes of thermal power plants can be divided into main control room and unit control room according to the control location. The latter also includes unit control room with network control and two types of independent unit control room and network control room. At present, in the operation and development of thermal power plants, the application of electrical control system has gradually deepened, and it has played a positive role in promoting the operation efficiency and quality of thermal power plants. Due to the application of fuzzy control algorithm, to a great extent, the overall operation quality of the electrical control system is improved, the control flow is further simplified, and the foundation for the healthy development of thermal power plants is laid. In the research, the technologies beneficial to system operation are integrated with the electrical control system to promote the optimization of the performance of the electrical control system. The research on the fusion of fuzzy control algorithms not only makes a great contribution to the efficiency improvement of thermal power plants, but also promotes the economic benefits of thermal power plants. Promote thermal power plants to gain a firm foothold in the current increasingly fierce market competition, and better promote the sound development of China’s electric power industry.

articleTitle: Cold Start Recommendation based on Cross-domain Sharing Knowledge Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Due to the sparse initial interaction data, the cold-start problem poses a challenge to recommendation networks, e-commerce websites, and video platforms, etc. Traditional user profiling can predict preferences but raises privacy concerns. To address this issue, this paper proposes a cross-domain knowledge-shared transfer learning model that is initially trained on a cross-domain mixed dataset to allow multi-task learning. This shared knowledge enhances the generalizability of the model and minimizes the dependence on sparse data. Different from traditional recommender systems, this model can utilize limited user-item interaction data to make accurate recommendations and reduce the cold-start problem. After initial training, the model is fine-tuned on the target domain data. To avoid overfitting and inefficiency, an extended Transformer module is used, extracting multi-scale hidden states and a Transformer encoder, which are updated at each time step. Experimental results on the Amazon dataset show that the model can adapt to new tasks more efficiently, reducing computational cost and risk of overfitting.

articleTitle: Construction of Power Grid Investment Optimization Model Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Enterprises in power grid are faced with great uncertainty in investment management, and their benefits fluctuate greatly. The efficiency of newly added assets fails to play an effective role, and the contradiction of input-output structure is more prominent. Faced with such a large scale of investment, how to determine the investment strategy of power grid and how to resist the huge risks brought by investment are crucial for the construction of national power grid and economic development. In this paper, based on the improved PSO (Particle swarm optimization) algorithm, the power grid investment is analyzed and optimized, and a model is built. Through simulation experiments and investment benefit simulation method, various investment schemes are optimized. On the basis of maximizing the return of the investment portfolio, increase the income items that may be brought by the remaining investment funds in the objective function. Improved PSO algorithm is used to solve the optimization problem of power grid investment. The main improvement point is that, if the optimal results of particle swarm remain unchanged for successive generations, combined with the macroscopic trend observation in real practice, the variance value of the production function on the calculation index will be greatly reduced, and after the quantitative analysis data are compared, the objective will be optimized efficiently.

articleTitle: Charging Station System Based on IoT Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the increase of environmental pollution, especially the influence of severe weather conditions such as smog, the demand for clean energy vehicles is increasing day by day, and the rapid development of electric vehicles has put forward higher requirements for the technology, efficiency and flexibility of charging systems. This paper proposes a design scheme of a charging station control system based on the Internet of Things platform. The system has powerful performance, is very flexible, and is easy to expand. This paper discusses the design and implementation of the charging control system in detail from the aspects of system scheme design and IoT platform management and operation. In the system performance test, the experimental results show that the accuracy comparison is less than 3% under the current data acquisition, so it meets the system’s requirements for current acquisition accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Robot Interactive Emotion Model Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: At present, in AI (artificial intelligence) and machine learning, most learning and decision-making algorithms only consider the external motivation rewards from external goals or costs, but ignore the motivation rewards from the internal cognition and emotion of the machine itself. This paper mainly constructs a set of robot interactive emotion model based on AI technology, and uses the end-to-end generation model to generate a reasonable reply that best fits the situation by combining emotional factors. The Chinese text is classified by using the character-level CNN (Convolutional Neural Network). In the actual dialogue scene classification, the word vector similarity classification method is integrated to improve the scene distribution accuracy of the model in this paper and increase the user experience. The emotional evaluation results show that the average value of ECM (Emotional Chat Machine) model is 1.213, and the average value of the model proposed in this paper is 1.618, with a difference of 0.405. The results show that the model proposed in this paper is superior to the ECM model in emotional content expression, and the sentences generated by the model proposed in this paper have content information close to the topic.

articleTitle: Design of a Contrast Enhancement Algorithm for Visual Communication Images Based on PSO
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Image contrast enhancement is one of the key technologies in image processing, which can improve image quality and visual effect. It is of great practical significance to study the contrast enhancement of visual communication images. Traditional methods have poor visual communication performance in enhancing visual communication images. Aiming at the above problems, in order to improve the contrast enhancement results of visual communication images, this paper proposes a contrast enhancement algorithm of visual communication images based on PSO(Particle swarm optimization). The improved PSO algorithm is used to intelligently process the image. Through the normalization of gray image pixels, combined with Beta function, the parameters of transform function are optimized, and the image is automatically enhanced according to the obtained parameter values. According to the fitness value of the population, the particles falling in different classifications are classified, and then different weight transformation strategies are adopted to realize the dynamic updating of the weights. The research results show that the convergence performance of the improved algorithm proposed in this paper is obviously better than that of the standard PSO algorithm. The output SNR of image contrast enhancement processing under visual communication technology is higher and the visual information enhancement ability is better. The proposed method can obtain more ideal contrast enhancement effect, and the overall visual effect of the image has been significantly improved.

articleTitle: Construction of Mobile Intelligent Service System for Urban Gymnasium Based on Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The concept of engaging in sports has changed, and the public’s investment in sports consumption is on the rise, which has been confirmed by many scholars. The simulated annealing algorithm integrates functions such as remote sensing applications, navigation and positioning, and location services, and takes a specific spatial data as the analysis object. Reasonable ranking of sports competitions can not only make the competition fair and smooth, but also effectively realize the purpose of competition value, thereby attracting more participants and spectators and creating the greatest value of the competition. It is an application of technologies such as the Internet of Things, cloud computing, next-generation communication networks, high-performance information processing, and intelligent data mining in urban life experience, industrial development, and administrative management. The informatization degree of the sports center operation management system lags behind the construction and development process of sports undertakings and the pace of economic and technological development. Simulated annealing algorithm is an intelligent optimization algorithm developed to solve practical combinatorial optimization problems using solid annealing principle. Therefore, it has become the preferred technology for the design of the service system of urban stadiums and gymnasiums. A stadium is a building for indoor sports competitions and exercises. As a part of smart city thematic application, the accessibility of spatial objects is mainly analyzed based on the urban stadium system. The simulated annealing algorithm is used to solve the problem on the basis of establishing an integer standard programming model and analyzing the properties of the model. In this paper, the application status of simulated annealing algorithm in open booking of urban stadiums and gymnasiums is analyzed, aiming at market prospects of “Mobile Intelligent Service Technology + Stadium Opening” and improving the application level.

articleTitle: Application Research of Temperature Tracing Leakage Detection Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Leakage is one of the main hidden dangers that endanger the safety of dams. Leakage will lead to the loss of soil particles. If leakage is allowed to develop, it will further form a centralized leakage channel, which may lead to dam collapse or landslide, or even burst the dam, resulting in serious consequences. There are often many centralized leakage channels in dams. If all leakage channels cannot be detected, after the main channel is treated, the secondary leakage channel will gradually develop into the main channel, which will continue to cause harm to dams. Therefore, based on PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization) algorithm, this paper further studies the application of temperature tracing leakage detection. Joint detection is mainly carried out by electrical method and tracer method. Finally, through the simulation results, we can see two main concentrated leakage channels, the center positions of which are 1200.00m and 1400.00m m. In addition, there are two secondary centralized leakage channels, and their centers are 800.47m and 1900.60m m. It can also be explained that the scale of secondary leakage channels is small, and large-scale centralized leakage channels have not yet been formed. It is proved that this optimization algorithm can be used in temperature tracing to determine the central position of concentrated leakage of dam.

articleTitle: Low-altitude Airspace Conflict Detection and Avoidance Algorithm Based on Computer Vision and Multi-sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The development and application bring a large quantity of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) flight activities, which directly affect the flight safety in complex airspace. UAV path planning algorithm is based on the task type to be completed, and then combined with the known planning space and terrain information, it plans an optimal path for UAV or UAV group that conforms to the real flying of UAV. Improving UAV’s perception and avoidance ability and avoiding the collision danger between UAVs or between UAVs and manned aircraft is a core ability for UAV to enter non-isolated airspace. In order to prevent aircraft from colliding in low-altitude airspace, this paper analyzes the conflict prediction and avoidance methods between aircraft flying at the same altitude in low-altitude airspace, and puts forward the conflict detection and avoidance algorithm in low-altitude airspace based on binocular stereo vision and multi-sensors. In order to get more accurate position information faster, stereo vision and optical flow are combined. The experimental results show that this method can effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of avoidance.

articleTitle: Design of Fast Distribution Network Fault Location Algorithm Based on Multi-information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The intelligent transformation of distribution network and the development of communication technology make the protection of distribution network develop in the direction of “intelligence” and “informatization”, which makes the protection of distribution network seek more operation information to improve its decision-making. Although modern power system has installed many monitoring facilities and adopted advanced protection and control measures, it still cannot prevent the occurrence of power grid faults. In this paper, a fast fault location algorithm of distribution network based on multi-information fusion is proposed, which decomposes the running signal of electrical equipment by wavelet packet and realizes the feature extraction of the fault signal of electrical equipment. In order to realize the adaptive optimization of distribution network relay protection strategy, according to the relay protection fault handling process, the protection is divided into fault identification and export decision-making, and on this basis, a two-level optimization method of distribution network relay protection strategy based on the fusion of operation mode and fault information is proposed. The failure of distribution network is analyzed by an example, which verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm and proves that the algorithm has a positive role in promoting the practical level of distribution automation in regional power grids.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Meter System Based on GPS Automatic Positioning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: At present, it is difficult to quickly and accurately locate a large number of meters in the meter box, so that the meters that need to be maintained and replaced can be located. In this paper, the design and implementation of an intelligent meter rapid location system are introduced. The design idea of this paper is to integrate GPS automatic positioning technology with smart meter system, and build smart meter system based on GPS automatic positioning technology. And elaborate the design scheme and ideas of smart meter system. The accuracy of crystal oscillator circuit is improved by GPS technology, and the time of crystal oscillator circuit is the secondary standard. This design scheme can complement each other and improve the time accuracy of smart meter system. The results show that the error of this algorithm is low and the accuracy is high, which can reach 95.98%. Moreover, when there are many transaction sets, the system can still maintain the stability of about 90%. The smart meter system based on GPS technology can effectively solve the problems such as automatic positioning of meters, and can effectively achieve the purpose of fast searching and positioning of smart meters on site. In order to provide some ideas for related research.

articleTitle: Research on Data Acquisition and Reconstruction Algorithm of Sensor Layer in Internet of Things Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Wireless sensor network (WSN), as a new information collection method, has the advantages of high data sensing accuracy, good environmental adaptability, large coverage area, good concealment and strong invulnerability. Due to the limitation of sensor nodes' own size and WSN's working environment, the energy of sensor nodes in the network is generally limited, and it can't be replenished after the energy is exhausted, which makes it impossible to deploy and apply WSN on a large scale and for a long time in practice. In this paper, a data acquisition and reconstruction algorithm for the sensor layer of the Internet of Things (IOT) based on back propagation neural network (BPNN) and compressed sensing theory is proposed. Under the premise of ensuring the accuracy of data collection, the redundant information of the original data is removed to the greatest extent by compressing the member nodes and cluster head nodes in the cluster, and the data transmission in the network is reduced. The simulation results show that compared with the WSN data acquisition method in literature [9], the energy consumption of the WSN data acquisition method in this paper is reduced by more than 10%. The proposed algorithm can reduce the reconstruction complexity and reconstruction delay of the fusion center without increasing the compressed observation dimension, thus achieving the purpose of reducing network transmission energy consumption.

articleTitle: Communication Combination Technology and Routing Protocol Algorithm Design Based on Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The communication network is developing towards high reliability, high utilization and high quality of service. The existing routing algorithm has been difficult to meet the development requirements, and it is necessary to find a new algorithm. ANN (Artificial neural network) has absorbed many advantages of biological NN. Based on ANN model, this paper discusses the design of communication combination technology and routing protocol algorithm. In this paper, many advantages of CNN (Convective neural network) similar to biological NN are analyzed, and then a new routing protocol algorithm based on CNN is proposed on the basis of describing CNN model and CNN learning algorithm. This paper demonstrates the correctness and rationality of the algorithm in detail, introduces the operational feasibility of the algorithm, and explains the calculation process of the algorithm in detail. Finally, the simulation experiment is carried out by MATLAB. The simulation results show that with the continuous iteration of the algorithm, the error of the algorithm can be stabilized at about 0.51, the operation efficiency of the algorithm is about 0.17, and the accuracy is high. The routing protocol algorithm has excellent performance, which can effectively improve the energy utilization rate of WSN (Wireless sensor network) and prolong the network lifetime.

articleTitle: Optimization Simulation of Network Retrieval Model Based on Big Data Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The traditional keyword-based information retrieval service can only return the results matching keywords according to the user’s query conditions, and the retrieval mechanism is relatively simple, leaving out a lot of information with similar content but different expressions. This paper proposes and implements an optimization method of network retrieval model based on big data algorithm. The model expanded by term similarity includes arcs that simulate the direct relationship between terms, which mainly expand the term subnet. According to the quantitative synonym relationship between terms, an extended BN (Bayesian network) retrieval model is established, and the retrieval results are presented to users in descending order of document relevance, thus realizing semantic-based information retrieval to some extent. The simulation results show that the average precision/recall ratio of the proposed retrieval strategy is higher than that of the traditional retrieval model, and the average precision ratio can reach 66.37%. Secondly, because the document is indexed offline, it is also better than the traditional retrieval model retrieval strategy in time consumption. Experiments show that compared with the traditional retrieval model, the proposed model has better retrieval performance. The model in this paper can expand the retrieval of related information without deviating from the user’s retrieval goal, and the ranking of related documents is more reasonable, and the quality of retrieval results is further improved.

articleTitle: Research on Visual Detection of Fluorescent Carbon Quantum Dot Sensor Based on Hydrothermal Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As a new type of fluorescent material, CQDs (Carbon Quantum Dots) have attracted much attention due to their unique optical properties, good biocompatibility, and low cytotoxicity. They have important applications in optoelectronic devices, analysis and detection, and cell imaging application. This paper mainly focuses on the preparation, application and fluorescence enhancement of CQDs to carry out related research. Using citric acid and tri (hydroxymethyl) aminomethane as raw materials, blue highly fluorescent CQDs were synthesized by one-step hydrothermal method. The synthesis of CQDs was optimized by changing the reaction conditions. By studying the effect of different pH values on the fluorescence intensity of CQDs, it was concluded that the fluorescence intensity of CQDs was the strongest at pH 7. The fluorescence changes of CQDs under different ionic strengths and different solvents were studied. The results showed that different ionic strengths had little effect on CQDs fluorescence, but different solvents showed a certain fluorescence quenching effect. Experiments show that the CQDs can be used as a fluorescent marker for biological imaging.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Power Equipment Condition Prediction and Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As a method, artificial intelligence technology has been widely used in engineering technology. The fault diagnosis system of power system is complex, and it is difficult to diagnose accurately by conventional methods. A maintenance method for health state prediction of power equipment is proposed. The historical maintenance data of equipment is used as input information, and the output results are obtained through the prediction model constructed by artificial neural network (ANN) algorithm. According to the prediction results, the equipment health state evaluation grade and corresponding maintenance measures are established, In order to realize the health status evaluation and accurate status prediction of equipment, so as to formulate a scientific maintenance plan, achieve the purpose of minimizing the occurrence of faults and prolonging the service time of equipment, finally realize the preservation and appreciation of assets, preliminarily realize the fault prediction and health management of equipment, and help realize the transformation of equipment status maintenance.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Camouflaged Intrusion Detection Model Based on Improved RF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: It is of great significance to detect and stop camouflage intrusion quickly and effectively for maintaining the security of network resources. As an important technical means to maintain network security, camouflage intrusion security detection has attracted more and more attention. RF (Random forest) is a method that combines a series of decision subtrees, and then determines the final output result of samples according to the voting results of subtrees. In this paper, the simulation research of camouflage ID (intrusion detection) model based on improved RF algorithm is carried out. In this paper, an improved RF algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the mixed sampling method is adopted before RF is divided into subsets to reduce the imbalance of each subset.
