Then, the subtree with strong independence is selected from many decision trees to form the final RF. In the process, K-means algorithm is used to cluster the decision trees and extract the cluster center. The research results show that with the increase of information collection duration, the detection algorithm will show better performance. When the information collection time is 50 minutes, the system shows the best performance (ACC: 83.106%, FP: 12.615%). The improved RF algorithm can better eliminate the influence of redundant features on the model, and has better processing effect on unbalanced data.

articleTitle: Design of Landscape Interactive System Based on Artificial Intelligence Image Processing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The existing image optimization methods usually use convolution template and 3D landscape image to realize optimization design, but the convolution operation leads to the loss of image layout edge information to varying degrees. In order to improve the quality and efficiency of three-dimensional landscape drawing of digital city, firstly, according to the specific application of three-dimensional visualization technology of digital city, the urban spatial characteristic information is classified. In this article, the artificial intelligence (AI) image processing algorithm is applied to the 3D modeling of landscape architecture, and the initial weights of neural network are optimized based on real-coded convolutional neural network (CNN), and appropriate learning factors are selected to train the neural network, thus completing the information fusion task and providing technical support for the interactive design of landscape architecture.

articleTitle: Simulation of Electrical Power System Reserve Capacity Optimization Model Based on Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Electrical power system (EPS) needs to give consideration to the reliability and economy of system operation when allocating spare capacity. If the spare capacity is configured too much, the security and sufficiency of the system operation will be reduced, and if it is configured too much, the economy of the operation will be reduced unnecessarily. In the actual EPS operation process, due to the uncertainty of load and power generation changes, such as load changes and forced outage of units, power generation must be adjusted at any time according to load changes. In this article, an optimization model of EPS reserve capacity based on differential evolution (DE) algorithm is proposed, which improves the spatial exploration and development ability of DE algorithm, improves the accuracy of the solution and the convergence speed of the algorithm, and finally realizes the optimization of interconnected EPS reserve capacity with wind farms. The simulation results show that the accuracy of the improved DE algorithm can reach 96.75%, which is more than 15% higher than that of the traditional particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. Therefore, this method can effectively reduce the spare capacity configuration of the system on the premise of ensuring the security and stability of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in Electric Power Marketing Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the development of society and economy, power construction is also developing rapidly, and the reform of the power market brooks no delay. The power market is the operating environment of power enterprises, and power marketing is its core part, and power marketing management is the main factor to improve the effect of power marketing. Therefore, it is necessary to increase the reform of the power market to improve the power marketing management system. Power marketing management should follow the general direction of power market reform and propose a new management model system that adapts to the power market. This paper designs an advanced power marketing system, which can not only improve the efficiency of power marketing, but also strengthen the control of the power marketing market. The application of this platform in the power grid can continuously strengthen the operation of the power marketing management system.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of the Combination of Artificial Intelligence and Electrical Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence, the application of artificial intelligence technology in the field of electrical automation control has gradually become widespread, promoting the improvement of electrical control efficiency and the reduction of operating costs. In this paper, by outlining the latest progress of artificial intelligence technology, combined with the current development status of the field of electrical automation, the relevant contents of the combination of artificial intelligence and electrical automation are discussed in depth. This paper describes the actual cases and application ideas of “Artificial Intelligence Circuit Board Mapping” and “Artificial Intelligence Natural Gas Pipeline Pressure Control”, and explores the application of the electrical automation control field with artificial intelligence technology by taking the fault diagnosis generated by photovoltaic power plants as an example. On this basis, the combined application in related fields is further explored, providing theoretical experience and practical reference for future research and development in this field.

articleTitle: Design of Nondestructive Detection System for Magnetostrictive Guided Waves of Power Towers Based on Grey Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Power equipment is exposed to the wild for a long time, which is prone to various security risks. Regular inspection of transmission lines is an important guarantee to ensure power safety. Among them, tower inspection is an important part of transmission line inspection. Most of the traditional detection technologies can only detect the area where the sensor is located, so it is impossible to detect the difficult or impossible areas; MGW (magnetostrictive guided waves) can realize non-contact detection without coupling medium and allowing a certain lift-off distance. Based on the principle of MGW detection, this paper develops a nondestructive detection system for power tower MGW based on grey clustering algorithm. The whole detection system consists of host computer, excitation sensor, receiving sensor and preamplifier. Grey clustering algorithm is used to obtain the most suitable prior anchor frame, which makes it more in line with the shape and proportion of the tower. The research results show that the longitudinal guided waves are successfully excited by the designed guided wave detection system in power towers. Calculate the speed of sound of guided wave signal at the frequency of 300~1000kHz respectively, and compare it with the theoretical estimated value to calculate the error percentage. The results show that the error value of magnetostrictive ultrasonic guided wave detection system designed in this paper is mostly in the range of 2%, which can be well used in practical detection.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of WSN Network Communication Service Based on Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of single path and high energy consumption in current methods, this paper puts forward an optimization method of WSN (Wireless sensor network) network communication service based on DT (Decision tree) algorithm, in order to meet the optimization requirements of WSN network communication service, determine key parameters, take key variables as the input values of overrun fast learning machine, and use the learning machine to train and output the routing optimization results to complete network routing optimization. At the same time, PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization) algorithm is introduced, and penalty function method is used to help the algorithm get rid of the constraints of local minima and improve the optimization speed, and the improved PSO is introduced into DT tree-building method. The research results show that this method has high classification accuracy, can get the appropriate number of scientific variables, and improve the final routing optimization effect. With the increase of the number of nodes, the energy consumption of the proposed algorithm is about 33.3% of the literature algorithm. When the network scale reaches the maximum, its energy consumption is less than 150 mW, which ensures the synchronization accuracy and the energy utilization effect is good. Experiments show that the key parameters selected in this method can complete routing optimization, effectively improve data transmission rate and reduce energy consumption.

articleTitle: Design and Application of the Full Life Cycle of Electronic Transfer of GIS Platform Operation and Distribution Integrated Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the service level and refined management of the power grid, the data is collected and transferred to the corresponding system management. The main work of business distribution information integration is to improve the data quality. This article focuses on the research and analysis of the system engineering management module, analyzing and researching the distribution network engineering system, business expansion auxiliary decision-making system, and marketing system business expansion module. Taking a certain county as an example, the construction project of a certain county’s distribution network is an economic activity, and it is natural to actively pursue economic returns for investors throughout its entire lifecycle. According to the electricity prices of each voltage level, the increase in revenue due to increased electricity sales can be calculated. In 2022, the electricity prices per kilowatt hour for 110kV, 35kV, and 10kV distribution networks were 4.865 yuan, 4.235 yuan, and 3.423 yuan, respectively. This paper shows information through GIS platform, builds an enterprise level information integration platform with safe, open and interactive characteristics, and builds a business distribution integration system with real-time data sharing, cross department interaction and cross business flow. It is a very urgent and arduous task.

articleTitle: Design of Transmission Line Maintenance Tool Based on Artificial Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the change of the operation mode and structure of the power system, the requirements for the stability of the power grid and the reliability of the power supply are getting higher and higher, and it has become inevitable to maintain, overhaul and test the transmission equipment by live working. The causes of power system accidents are very complicated. Apart from natural factors, they are generally caused by defects in equipment manufacturing, improper design or installation, and ineffective maintenance and repair. Therefore, based on the ANN (artificial neural network) algorithm, this paper designs the maintenance tool for transmission lines, and makes further research on it. The research shows that when the A-phase short circuit occurs, the A-phase current increases sharply, while the B-phase and C-phase currents change little. When the AB phase short circuit occurs, the current of phase A and B increases sharply, while the current of phase C remains basically unchanged. The server sends the configured instrument tag number to the handheld terminal, and the handheld terminal recognizes the instrument tag information and displays it on the server to complete the instrument distribution function. With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, Internet, big data development and other technologies, the increase of hardware processing speed and the decrease of cost, the intelligent inspection of transmission lines has become a reality.

articleTitle: Simulation of Predictive Control Model of Machining Error Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The effect of machining is directly related to the growth of the whole industry, so it is of great significance to promote the growth of the industry through standardized technology. In machining, parts processing will be applied to multi-field production activities. If there are errors, it will directly affect the whole production process, so it is imperative to optimize and improve the technical errors of machining. It is an important method to predict and compensate the machining errors produced by the machining system to improve the machining accuracy. As far as the actual situation at this stage is concerned, good technological support is needed for the better growth of machining. In this article, the source and transmission mode of errors are analyzed. Aiming at the characteristics of high nonlinearity, multi-input and multi-output in machining process, a predictive control model of machining errors based on improved PSO-BPNN is proposed, and its superiority and universality are simulated and tested. The new algorithm can effectively reduce the overshoot of the system and shorten the adjustment time, so as to achieve better control effect, and has better tracking performance and adaptability.

articleTitle: Design of English Translation Model for Intelligent Recognition Based on Support Vector Machine Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Support vector machine algorithm is one of the most popular and effective algorithms in the field of statistical machine learning. The research work of support vector machine is mainly divided into two categories: one is single machine support vector machine algorithm for high efficiency; The other is efficient distributed support vector machine algorithm. However, the training efficiency of the existing fast support vector machine is still very slow. How to solve these problems and further improve the efficiency of support vector machine is still a topic worthy of research. In order to identify the non support vectors that do not work on the separation hyperplane, the concept of direction indicator is proposed to quantitatively analyze the position relationship between support vectors and non support vectors; At the same time, in order to prevent the occurrence of misidentified transactions, a non support vector confirmation algorithm based on voting mechanism is proposed; After eliminating non support vectors, the remaining data are trained by support vector machine algorithm to obtain the final model. Compared with the existing stacked support vector machine algorithm in distributed environment, it improves the efficiency of the algorithm and ensures the accuracy of the algorithm. This paper studies how to get the training model quickly in support vector machine.

articleTitle: Design of Coordinated Control Algorithm for Excitation and Valve of New Energy Generator Set Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The existing design methods of integrated controller will be difficult to implement when the mathematical model of the system is inaccurate or the specific parameters are unknown, which leads to the difficulty in ensuring the control effect and some limitations, which limits the practical engineering application of these design methods to some extent. In this paper, an algorithm for coordinated control of excitation and valve of new energy generator set based on ANN (artificial neural network) is proposed. FNN(Fuzzy neural network) combines the advantages of fuzzy control technology and ANN theory, so FNN is applied to coordinated control of excitation and valve of new energy generator set. Because the neural network has the function of learning and association, in the actual control process, when the error and its change rate match with the sample points, the controller directly reproduces the memorized principle, and when it does not match with the sample, the controller handles it with similar principle through association to realize the fuzzy control of the system. The simulation results show that the coordinated controller based on FNN has good artificial damping, small oscillation amplitude and adjustment time of only about 3.5s when the mechanical power input by 5s generator takes a 5% step. After the fault, FNN coordinated control method has a relatively small fluctuation range compared with the optimal coordinated control method, and can enter the stable operation state relatively early, showing good adaptability and robustness.

articleTitle: Design of Human Posture Recognition System Integrating Computer Vision and Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this article, a human posture recognition model combining computer vision and deep learning (DL) algorithm is proposed. Under the condition of keeping the data structure and sample labels unchanged, the model randomly cuts the video frame images by using the horizontal translation matrix, which effectively expands the data set samples, thus reducing the risk of over-fitting of the model to some extent. The experimental results show that the improved human target detection algorithm in this article can effectively improve the detection performance of the algorithm, and the computational complexity of the human posture recognition algorithm is small, which increases the correlation between adjacent video frames in the recognition process, and improves the accuracy of posture recognition while ensuring real-time. The realization of this algorithm is of great significance for building a simplified human posture recognition system with high response and accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Nonlinear Enhancement Algorithm for Satellite Communication Signals Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The traditional nonlinear enhancement technology of communication signal mainly focuses on the improvement based on spread spectrum communication system, including signal design with low interception probability, dynamic modulation technology and spatial filtering. These studies are still mainly based on spread spectrum system, and the key technologies are continuously optimized and enhanced to improve and develop the traditional anti-jamming performance. With the attack of AI craze and the continuous development of deep learning, it is more effective to use AI algorithm to directly take interference signals as input, so that computers can actively learn from interference signals and mine different features. In this paper, a nonlinear enhancement algorithm for satellite communication signals is studied in combination with deep learning, and interference learning and estimation are realized based on improved CNN (Convolutional Neural Network). The learning network will output an interference estimation signal with the same length as the input signal, and the interference suppressed signal can be obtained by eliminating this signal from the original network input signal. The simulation results show that when the guard bandwidth accounts for 15% of the total bandwidth, the influence on the demodulation performance of the signal after spectrum shaping is about 0.5dB. Using the nonlinear enhancement strategy of satellite communication signal based on deep learning can reduce the in-band power fluctuation from 3.2dB to 0.64dB, and enhance the signal concealment.

articleTitle: Precise Positioning and Personalized Recommendation Algorithm of Smart Library Based on User Portrait
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of big data, Internet and cloud technologies, the trend of digitalization and informatization of libraries has become more and more obvious, so the services provided to readers are not only borrowing, reading and returning, but also adding personalized services, namely accurate positioning and personalized services of smart libraries. User portrait provides a powerful tool for the library to understand users, gain insight into users, and then realize personalized intelligent services with knowledge, scene and initiative. In this paper, the author will systematically expound the characteristics and requirements of personalized intelligent service in libraries, integrate the application of user portraits into personalized service system, and design a model framework of personalized intelligent service in libraries based on user portraits.

articleTitle: Development of neutral line live detection device for 400v low-voltage distribution network based on 4G mobile communication network transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The neutral line is one of the components of the whole distribution transformation system. In the 400v low-voltage distribution network, the neutral point, that is, the neutral line, will be directly grounded to form an equal potential with the earth. Without potential difference, the neutral line will naturally not be charged and be in a safe state. Based on wireless communication technology, this paper develops a neutral line live detection device for 400v low-voltage distribution network. Using the transmission of 4G mobile communication network, the embedded fault detection software of wireless acquisition unit is designed based on single-chip SOC chip to complete the data acquisition and wireless transmission of current transformer. Aiming at 400v low-voltage distribution network, the live location criterion based on zero-sequence current mutation is used to locate the neutral line. The research results show that the maximum accuracy of the proposed method is 96.04% and the average is 88.58%. It shows that the proposed neutral line live detection method for power equipment is extremely effective. The validity of the detection device in this paper is proved.

articleTitle: Design of Urban Traffic Control Algorithm Based on Traffic Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Urban intersections are the main locations where traffic congestion occurs, especially in second tier cities with high traffic volume and underdeveloped transportation. Many level crossings have insufficient capacity compared to the average capacity of relevant road sections. The traffic volume of urban roads is constantly increasing, and the supply speed of road infrastructure is far less than the growth rate of traffic demand. The supply and demand of traffic has become seriously imbalanced, and traffic congestion occurs every day in the road network of first and second tier cities in China, causing significant difficulties for the daily travel of urban residents. In this regard, this paper designs the urban traffic control algorithm based on the traffic big data, which can scientifically organize the traffic data resources, thus realizing the timely processing of massive data, and can efficiently process the traffic data. This is the prominent advantage of big data and other technologies in the field of intelligent transportation. The experimental results show that the coordinated control method is far superior to single point timed control in terms of travel time on the main line and total traffic delay time within the control area. Prove that the control algorithm proposed in this paper is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Intelligent Construction Management Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Optimization technology is a basic technology of modern scientific management methods. In order to meet the optimization needs of solving large-scale complex problems in modern management, effective optimization technology is urgently needed. Many typical quantitative model optimization problems have been solved. Since the 1950s, when the theory of project management came into being, along with the development of social economy, the fields involved in project management have become more and more extensive, and the depth of its research problems has also increased. Under the premise of limited resources, how to make reasonable arrangements for various activities in the project so as to ensure that the project can be completed on schedule and with good quality has become a common concern in the field of enterprise management. Based on the improved ant colony algorithm, this paper studies the multi-mode project scheduling management of construction projects. In the machine algorithm, the ant path of the feasible schedule of RCPSP problem can be constructed by repeating the selection process until the project terminates the process and setting the earliest start time of each selected process. After research, this algorithm is superior to the traditional algorithm, and it is suitable to be widely put into practice.

articleTitle: Research on Power Security Management and Control System Based on Big Data Algorithm and Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Safety has always been the eternal theme of power grid construction and development. State Grid Corporation always puts safety in production at the top of all its work. In order to adapt to the promotion of national economy and the development of State Grid Corporation, it is necessary to ensure the safe and stable operation of the national power supply system and reliable power supply for the people. How to implement effective management and control, achieve comprehensive coverage of production site safety supervision in the jurisdiction and its subordinate jurisdictions, avoid supervision blind spots, and realize remote supervision anytime and anywhere is a problem worthy of discussion. In this paper, the simulation data show that the safety management system designed in this paper has a lower risk coefficient of field operation than the initial system, which can effectively ensure the safety of field workers and instruments. There are inherent disadvantages such as poor global coordination, lack of active early warning, and lag of system fusion data. It has obvious advantages in stability, autonomy of management and control, accuracy of early warning, and intelligence of operation and maintenance in extreme environments. Through big data algorithm and Internet of Things technology, the differentiated power safety management and control needs of power companies can be met, which has good popularization and application value.

articleTitle: Research on Learning Motivation Based on Matrix Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Based on literature analysis and expert consultation, 19 main factors influencing the learning motivation of secondary vocational students have been selected. A model has been established based on the AISM, obtaining the original adjacency matrix, a series of matrix operations and topological operations, and in turn obtaining multiplication matrix, reachable matrix, skeleton matrix and general skeleton matrix, etc. Finally, a set of directed topological hierarchy graphs with game antagonistic properties are obtained to analyze the relationship between the influencing factors.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on the Key Issues of Electricity Market Structure and Transmission Congestion Based on Financial Transmission Rights
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the deepening of the marketization of the power system, the scale of transmission congestion in the power system based on node price mechanism will continue to increase. Therefore, it is necessary to adopt effective methods to solve the key problems of transmission congestion that may be encountered by power users. In the market model of bilateral transactions, as a financial tool to avoid congestion risk, the FTR forces its holder to obtain corresponding financial compensation when the transmission network is blocked. Electricity traders with transmission rights can effectively avoid the risk of transmission congestion in the electricity market. This paper takes the financial transmission right as the research object. First, it analyzes the European transmission congestion management and typical power market methods. Combined with the current situation of China’s power market structure and market congestion allocation, it analyzes the problems existing in the current congestion surplus allocation method. It proposes a compensation allocation mechanism design suitable for the financial transmission right blocking environment of China’s power Spot market, and verifies the effectiveness of this mechanism through an example.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Financial Management System Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Data Mining (DM) technology is a technique that extracts potential and valuable knowledge from massive amounts of data.At present, big data technology has been widely used in all fields in the world. If enterprises want to make great progress, they must keep up with the pace of the times. Therefore, the management mode of enterprises is becoming more and more networked and information-based, and in the management of enterprises, financial management is gradually approaching networking. Therefore, the design of financial software must meet the needs of the network. In order to enhance the core competitiveness of enterprises and make them invincible in the industry, we must start from the inside of enterprises, change the business philosophy, and strengthen enterprise financial management combined with modern information system.The financial work of an enterprise requires the accuracy of data collection and accurate information and data management. Especially for the financial management of large-scale enterprises, it has more complex operation difficulties, which brings greater work to the financial staff of the enterprise burden. Therefore, DM algorithms and financial management systems are necessary. This paper briefly expounds the relevant theories, methods and technologies of the visual DM technology and the construction of the financial management information system of DM.

articleTitle: Modeling and Optimization Design of Food Frozen Processing Process Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The use value of food is reflected in its edibility. With the growth of economy and the continuous improvement of people’s living standards, people have higher and higher requirements for the quality of frozen food, and the freezing process is also developing in the direction of low temperature, high speed and improving the quality of frozen products. Food freezing is an essential link in food preservation and processing technology. In order to improve the quality, technology and economy of food freezing, computer simulation can be used to study the freezing time and cooling stage of food on the basis of experiments. In this article, an optimization model of processing control based on genetic algorithm (GA) is proposed to model and analyze the food freezing process, so as to reduce the operation speed and improve the accuracy of the results, and then realize the optimization of the food freezing process. The improved GA can operate in parallel from multiple points and conduct efficient heuristic search in the solution space, which overcomes the disadvantages of starting from a single point and the blindness of search, thus making the optimization speed faster and avoiding falling into the local optimal solution prematurely.

articleTitle: Research on Instantaneous Parameter Extraction of Partial Discharge Signal Based on Grey Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The identification therapy of instantaneous characteristic parameters is widely used because of its inherent advantages. The instantaneous feature transformation is sensitive to noise interference, but the actual communication signals all contain noise without exception. If the instantaneous parameters are directly obtained by the analytical signal method, it will lack physical meaning and be distorted. Aiming at this phenomenon, this paper studies the extraction of instantaneous parameters of partial discharge signals based on grey clustering algorithm. Because of its good time-frequency localization, grey clustering algorithm is widely used in the extraction and detection of instantaneous parameters of partial discharge signals. The instantaneous frequency characteristics of partial discharge signals can reflect the frequency variation of signals at different times. Compared with the traditional time-frequency analysis method, the time-frequency analysis method in the grey clustering algorithm has the advantages of high frequency resolution, strong noise resistance and no cross-term interference, which makes it possible to accurately extract the instantaneous frequency of signals by improving the grey clustering algorithm. The simulation results show that the time interval between the two shocks is 0.13 s after the original signal is decomposed by grey clustering algorithm. Obviously, the frequency of each main impact sequence is completely consistent with the rotating frequency of the rotor.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Identification System of Electrical Measuring Instrument Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid judgment of equipment running faults in substations, the previous manual inspection, meter reading and recording modes can no longer meet the requirements of substation management and production efficiency, and the automatic counting technology of instrument indication is directly related to the development process of substation automation and informatization. In order to improve the reliability of power grid transaction data, aiming at the problem that the current measurement error correction methods of power measuring instruments have poor measurement data error verification ability, resulting in a big difference between error correction results and ideal results, a measurement error correction method of power measuring instruments based on artificial intelligence technology is designed. In order to build a more intelligent substation, more and more inspection robots are used to detect instruments in substations. According to the EM-KF principle of artificial intelligence technology, combined with the types and characteristics of error data, the error correction of measurement data is completed. The calibration experiment link of electric power measuring instruments is constructed. Through the measurement of multiple environments and experimental conditions, it is determined that the data obtained after using the new error correction method is closer to the ideal data, and the use effect of this method is good.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an IoT-Based Ecological Environment Monitoring Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In response to the problems of high deployment and maintenance costs of traditional environmental monitoring systems, the difficulty of adaptive collection of various types of ecological data information and real-time and reliable transmission of environmental monitoring data, an ecological and environmental monitoring IoT technology based on a multisensor network platform is proposed. The proposed framework subdivides the surveillance region into distinct environmental zones. Each of these zones is responsible for capturing a diverse range of ecological data through specialized sensors, such as those for temperature, humidity, and ambient noise, configured as per the monitoring requirements. In the surveillance area, mobile agent nodes are deployed. These nodes establish a real-time, two-dimensional positioning grid based on network energy metrics. The framework employs the ROSEN gradient projection technique to determine the most energy-efficient routing path. Data collected through this framework are then routed to the centralized control station for further analysis. Our simulation studies and mathematical evaluations confirm that this framework offers a reliable and time-sensitive solution for remote environmental data gathering, while also minimizing the network's overall energy footprint.

articleTitle: Application of Adaptive Neighborhood Denoising Algorithm in Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As the basis of image processing, image denoising has always been a research hotspot in the field of computer vision. The purpose of image denoising is to suppress noise from the distorted image and restore the image as much as possible, so that the restored surround image is closer to the original image in quality. Aiming at the Neigh Shrink method used in wavelet image denoising, this paper proposes an effective image denoising algorithm to protect the image edge. Mainly improving the fixed neighborhood range in the Neighbor Shrink method, adaptively segmenting the image into different neighborhoods for denoising based on its own properties; And further combining the correlation within the wavelet layer, fixed windows were added to each irregular neighborhood, and coefficients with geometric distances closer and within the same irregular neighborhood were selected to improve the Neigh Shrink method. We studied image enhancement based on wavelet transform, first analyzed the basic methods of image enhancement, and then put image enhancement into the wavelet domain for research. We proposed a new adaptive image enhancement algorithm using wavelet transform, and verified its feasibility and superiority in the environment.

articleTitle: Simulation of Microgrid Data Exchange Model Based on Support Vector Machine Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Microgrid, as a supplement to large power grid, has great development potential in its application. Data exchange system is a business system based on data exchange model, and its core functions mainly include data transmission and data processing. In this paper, the simulation research of microgrid data exchange model based on SVM (support vector machine) algorithm is carried out. Based on SOA technology architecture, a data exchange model is established. A fuzzy membership function model based on SVM is proposed, which can effectively classify the data in unclassifiable areas according to the distance between data points and classification hyperplane. The simulation results show that the average classification accuracy of this method is 91.295%, and the division of membership degree improves the anti-noise ability of SVM and ensures the prediction accuracy. Provide uniform data exchange standards and data exchange interfaces for power enterprises, and meet the vertical data penetration and horizontal application interaction requirements of the whole company.

articleTitle: Optimization of Software Engineering Supervision Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Sound supervision regulations and technical standards, forming a professional supervision team, and implementing the software engineering project supervision system are not only the common practice and successful experience in the world, but also the objective requirements of the software industry and the only way for the healthy development of the software industry. This paper establishes a comprehensive mathematical optimization model for the quality, cost, construction period and resources of software engineering supervision, and makes comprehensive optimization of multiple objectives. The improved machine learning algorithm is applied to the optimization process of the parts project supervision network plan, and the algorithm flow of the software engineering supervision network plan optimization is designed satisfactory solution.

articleTitle: Simulation of Power System Transient Stability Based on Improved PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the increasing scale of power grid, the rapid increase of electricity consumption, the continuous access of new energy, the increasingly complex model and the increasing requirement of reliability, the transient stability of power grid has become increasingly important. Therefore, this paper uses IPSO (Improved Particle Swarm Optimization) algorithm to simulate the transient stability of power system. On the basis of theory, the expression of S-type function is constructed, and the main parameters are determined according to different test functions. Considering that the improvement of convergence characteristics is limited only by changing the inertia weight, the feedback mechanism and mutation operator are introduced to establish the S-type inertia weight mutation PSO algorithm. The simulation results of an example show that the convergence speed of this algorithm is faster than that of the simple PSO algorithm because of the introduction of S-type inertia weight in PSO algorithm, and the calculation time is much shorter than that of PSO algorithm. It shows that the calculation accuracy of IPSO is consistent with that of implicit trapezoidal method, and it can be applied to transient stability simulation of power system.

articleTitle: Digital Analysis of Automotive Equipment Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In the process of defining automobile products, how to analyze consumers’ equipment needs is a big problem. The traditional method is mainly research method, which quantifies consumers' needs through different population surveys. However, the traditional quantitative method mainly relies on simple undetermined coefficient method and KANO model method, with relatively single dimensions and relatively high requirements for practitioners’ experience. With the help of machine learning method, more dimensions of data can be introduced and the analysis process is easier to visualize, so as to realize the migration and reuse of analysis model, and then support the digital management of products. With the help of more mature K-means clustering method, this paper uses the original data of consumer research to cluster, quantitatively analyze the equipment needs, and divide five clusters: prospective equipment, secondary equipment, essential equipment, charm equipment and desire equipment, so as to excavate the real needs of consumers and support the decision-making work of digital automobile equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation and Reconstruction of Digital Sculpture 3D Models Based on Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Film and television production began using digital carving software, which sculpted character images directly on a computer using a mouse or pressure pen. In the traditional production process of industrialization of film and television works, concept designers are usually only responsible for one or two preliminary tasks such as hand drawn sketches, which makes it impossible for designers to directly intervene and can only be achieved by visual effects implementation teams. This article attempts to simulate and reconstruct a digital sculpture 3D (Three Dimensional) model based on the DL (Deep Learning) algorithm. Finally, through experimental verification and analysis, it is shown that the average recognition rate of the algorithm proposed in this paper can reach 91.36%, and its performance is superior to the other two algorithms. However, the recognition rate of ordinary SAR image source algorithms is only 66.68%. The recognition rate of the enhanced Lee filtering algorithm is 82.14%. However, for the simulation time, as the recognition algorithm presented in this article adopts a new recognition algorithm based on a hybrid network of multi-layer RBM and GRNN, its simulation time is relatively long. This method can effectively improve the correct recognition rate of targets and is an effective SAR image target recognition method. Implement abstract description and classification of input images, and simulate and reconstruct real digital sculpture 3D models.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Seismic Model of Building Structures Based on Hybrid Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In today’s modernization, although there are few casualties under the earthquake, the economic losses are huge. Performance-based seismic design method can select performance targets according to the engineering site conditions and the importance of building structures, and realize the performance targets quantitatively in the design. In this paper, a method for predicting the seismic performance of frame structures based on uniform deformation and hybrid intelligent algorithm of differential evolution (DE) and particle swarm optimization (PSO) is proposed, and the iterative calculation of bending-shear frame structures with different floors is carried out, so that the high-precision uniform deformation optimization design is realized and the optimal stiffness distribution law of structural floors is obtained. The running performance of the algorithm is simulated and analyzed through experiments. Compared with the existing research results, it is verified that the established empirical function has high accuracy, which can provide accurate and effective reference for structural optimization design oriented to uniform deformation and improve calculation efficiency. optimizing the design of building structure can not only make the design scheme meet the requirements of seismic code, but also ensure that the important performance indexes of the structure are optimal or better, thus realizing the performance-based seismic design concept.

articleTitle: Construction of Information Interaction Platform for Power Communication Automation Based on Grey Clustering Algorithm under Cloud Edge Collaboration Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The amount of information to be transmitted and processed in smart grid is increasing rapidly. Cloud collaboration can’t be achieved by an enterprise only by its own strength or one or two partners, nor can it be achieved by only adopting a few new technologies. The ability of cloud-side collaboration has greatly improved the efficiency of enterprises. A reliability optimization algorithm of power communication network based on improved clustering algorithm is proposed. Through two processes: inter-community reliability analysis and backup method, intra-community reliability analysis and backup method, the key resources of power communication network are identified and backed up. The results show that the network connectivity of this algorithm is about 0.76 in random attack environment, and that of the traditional algorithm is about 0.55. It shows that this algorithm can effectively improve the network connectivity in random attack environment.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Safety Auxiliary Monitoring Method for Electric Deep Foundation Pit Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This paper builds a centralized and integrated electric power deep foundation pit operation monitoring data platform based on technologies such as the Internet of Things, cloud computing, big data, and BIM. The platform is compatible with manual monitoring and automatic monitoring. The system includes functions such as automatic monitoring data processing, intelligent monitoring data calibration, automatic report generation, strong three-dimensional visualization, real-time and accurate release of monitoring information, and integrated office management. Through experimental simulation, it is found that the system improves the safety monitoring and early warning level of the construction site, and forms an overall solution involving real-time perception, timely transmission, intelligent identification, analysis and early warning of temporary support monitoring risky operation surfaces. The system has effectively promoted the integration of the ubiquitous power Internet of Things and the infrastructure work of power transmission and transformation projects.

Author Keywords: Electric power deep foundation pit operation

articleTitle: Design of the Core Data Traceability Method of Power Grid Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Because the massive power grid core data affects the efficiency of information traceability, it needs to rely on different number of traceability chains to obtain information quickly, so as to achieve better data traceability effect and improve the efficiency of power grid core data traceability. Therefore, a power grid core data traceability method based on blockchain technology is designed. Hash function is used to encrypt data. Based on blockchain technology, data blocks are filled and divided, and corresponding scheme is designed to authenticate user identity. The design strategy can update the traceability chain and update the transaction strategy block group of the access strategy. Through the combination of non-aggregation traceability and aggregation traceability, the core data of power grid is obtained, and the core data traceability model is constructed to realize the core data traceability of power grid. The experimental results show that under the condition of three chain blockchain traceability, the repeated traceability process is reduced, the core data of power grid can be obtained quickly, the effect of data traceability is ensured, and the efficiency of data traceability is improved.

articleTitle: Research on Performance and Optimization of Electric Vehicle Fuel Cell System Based on State Feedback
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Compared with traditional internal combustion engine vehicles, electric vehicles mainly have the advantages of low environmental pollution, high efficiency, low running noise, and the ability to use a variety of different energy sources. People in the automotive industry are constantly looking for new energy sources to replace oil, and adopting new technologies, new materials and new processes to improve the fuel economy of automobiles and reduce the exhaust emissions of automobiles. Aiming at the performance problem of electric vehicle fuel cell system, this paper uses the method of electric vehicle fuel cell system performance based on state feedback. The state feedback is different from many reported methods at present, that is, it uses the basic idea of modern control theory. Firstly, the state space mathematical model of the power system is established through theoretical analysis and experimental parameter identification. Then, based on the mathematical model, a practical state observer and state feedback controller are constructed. Finally, it is verified by off-line simulation and real vehicle drum experiment. Through this control method, the system performance of the fuel cell is improved, the lag time of the system is shortened, the system oscillation and overshoot are reduced, and the dynamic stability of the system is enhanced.

articleTitle: Intelligent Dispatching Model of Power System Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In order to minimize the power generation cost while satisfying the active power balance, the unit output, voltage level and line safety constraints should also be met. This paper introduces the application status and development trend of genetic algorithm in short-term economic dispatch of power system from two aspects: global convergence of generalized genetic algorithm and high efficiency of cell exclusion genetic algorithm. At the same time, the optimization of power system economic dispatch is also of great significance to environmental protection, energy conservation and cost control. Due to the restriction of valve point effect and embargo zone, the unit economic dispatch problem is non-convex, nonlinear, discontinuous and so on, which makes the optimal solution of this problem very difficult. By analyzing the application of traditional genetic algorithm in active load distribution, it is found that there are some shortcomings in dealing with constraint conditions, scaling fitness function and local search. Aiming at these shortcomings, an improved processing method-direct comparison-proportion method is proposed, which is combined with hill climbing algorithm to form an improved genetic algorithm for solving active load distribution problem, and then experimental calculation is carried out. The calculation results show that using the improved genetic algorithm to solve the active load distribution problem can overcome the shortcomings of the traditional genetic algorithm in constraint treatment, fitness function calibration, local search, etc. to some extent, so as to obtain a high-quality solution.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Power System Grounding Grid Fault System Based on Fuzzy Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The grounding grid of substation is an important structure to ensure the reliable operation and personal safety of substation. Because the grounding grid of substation is generally buried underground, it is impossible to diagnose and identify the fault intuitively when the grounding grid fails, thus endangering the stable and reliable operation of substation. In the field of power operation and maintenance, the previous fault diagnosis scheme has fallen behind, so how to predict and diagnose the fault data of electric power system (EPS) grounding network with high quality and high efficiency is a difficult problem that needs to be improved urgently. In this article, a new fault diagnosis method of EPS grounding grid is studied and designed, which combines fuzzy control calculator with big data algorithm model, extracts fault data characteristics of EPS grounding grid based on improved big data algorithm model, and completes data diagnosis by analyzing the functional system of EPS grounding grid working condition. The simulation results show that the accuracy of this method has obvious advantages over the comparison algorithm in power fault data analysis after many iterations, and the accuracy is as high as 96.55%, which is 20.14% higher than that of SVM algorithm. Compared with the previous methods, the diagnostic sensitivity and accuracy of this method are significantly improved, which effectively solves the problems of low sensitivity and large diagnostic error in the fault detection of EPS grounding network in the prior art.

articleTitle: Analysis on Halo Characteristics and Thermal Effect of AC Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of urban construction and the buildings in residential and commercial areas are more and more dense, substations are also getting closer to residential and commercial areas which leads to noise pollution caused by the substation becoming more and more serious. Theoretical analysis shows that the transmission line surface to increase the insulation material can effectively reduce the outer electric field strength of the wire, thereby reducing corona noise. When the outer layer of the wire has coating material, the temperature of the outer layer of the wire is higher than that without coating material, and for the same coating material when the load capacity is certain, the coating material thickness increases, the temperature of the outer layer of the wire also increases. In order to analyze the impact of the coating layer used in the corona noise reduction process on the surface field strength and thermal effect of transmission lines, this paper establishes a finite element simulation model to calculate the changes in the electrical properties and thermal effect of the wire surface at different thicknesses of insulation materials at 1000 kV voltage level, which can effectively guide the design of corona noise reduction.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Customer Service Data Warehouse System for Electric Power Marketing Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Based on the continuous improvement of the informatization level of power grid and the increasing data accumulated in the information management system of power grid enterprises, this paper puts forward a power marketing analysis system based on data mining. In order to realize the design of the system architecture, require the system to meet the requirements of compatibility and share system information, an electric power marketing analysis system is designed. Design business architecture, application architecture, data architecture and technical architecture according to the requirements analysis results. The power marketing analysis system mainly includes data mining module, result analysis module and system management module. In order to ensure the security of the system, the security structure of the system is designed and tested. Practice shows that the system has strong management ability, decision-making ability and query ability, fast response speed, simple operation and good interface, which can improve the competitiveness and economic benefits of enterprises.

Author Keywords: data warehouse system design and implementation

articleTitle: Research on Perceptual Quantitative Static Evaluation Model of Intelligent Cockpit
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Under the background of automobile reform, software defines automobile and intelligent cockpit becomes the inevitable development direction of the industry. At present, the development and research of intelligent cockpit in the whole automobile industry is still in the initial exploratory stage. Therefore, it is of great significance to objectively and quantitatively evaluate and analyze intelligent cockpit products, feed back targeted feedback to relevant developers, and carry out product iteration, optimization and innovation. Based on the perspective of user perception, this paper aims to establish a set of specific and detailed static index system for the human-computer interaction content related to experience perception in the cockpit, and conduct standardized multi-dimensional test and evaluation to quantify the experience level of cockpit products. In terms of content, the whole set of static evaluation index system can involve comprehensive basic functions of static cockpit; In addition, the index system also includes the specific evaluation output of the richness of cabin ecological functions and users’ subjective experience. In terms of evaluation methods, the evaluation index system takes the intelligent cockpit perception quantitative diagnosis model combining subjective and objective as the bottom design, which lays a foundation for the further development of intelligent cockpit evaluation and technology development.

articleTitle: Time Series Forecasting Based on ARIMA and LSTM Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Prediction is to speculate and judge the future development trend through scientific methods according to the past and present information of the predicted object. Nowadays, prediction models are applied in various fields which made them have great research value in the academic field. In this paper, two different sets of time series data are used for forecasting research. Through preliminary analysis, we find that these two groups of data have the characteristics of large sample size and nonlinearity. After studying the relevant literature, we find that the LSTM model seems to have more advantages than the ARIMA model when studying data with large sample size and nonlinear characteristics. To verify this finding, we forecast our two sets of data separately with these two models, and then compare the prediction accuracy of the two models by correlation coefficient test, and find that the LSTM model has better results in predicting these two sets of data. This provides some theoretical support for our conjecture.

articleTitle: Adjustment Design of Relay Protection System Reliability Algorithm Based on Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the standardization of communication standards in the power industry, as well as the rapid development of power electronic technology and computer network communication technology, China’s substations are developing towards digitalization and intelligence. During the operation of the power system, various factors such as information data quality and operation environment will affect the operation of electronic devices, and the relay protection system will also be affected to a certain extent. During the operation of digital substation, advanced science and technology should be used as far as possible to realize the self-detection of the system, and the report upload and early warning should be carried out in combination with the detection results. When the transmission medium is used as the line segment between nodes, and other elements are used as nodes, the digital relay protection system can be regarded as a connected network system, The minimum path set method can be used to calculate the connectivity of the two-terminal network for the reliability of various information loops. Through fuzzy clustering algorithm, corresponding improvement measures can be taken in time to ensure the safety and reliability of digital substation relay protection system, which plays a vital role in promoting the operation of the entire power system, and it is of great significance to ensure the reliable operation of the current substation and promote the national economy.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of English Translation Error Recognition Algorithm Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Nowadays, there are a large number of bilingual translated texts on the Internet. It is a crucial problem to build a practical bilingual corpus through the processing of translated texts. Based on NN(neural network) encoder, the source language sequence with start and end marks is input, which is converted into distributed word vector data, and then transmitted to NN, including the background vector of source language information, which is input to decoder NN, and the target language sequence is calculated and input with NN as the carrier. This directly leads to the fact that when English translation robots translate English audio, it is difficult to get the same English audio data as the original text, thus reducing translation efficiency or causing translation errors. Improve the ability to eliminate translation errors. In this paper, PSO (particle swarm optimization) algorithm is put forward to optimize it. Simulation results show that the recognition speed of this algorithm is relatively high, and PSO algorithm is used to automatically optimize it, which realizes the elimination of English translation errors. Finally, the experimental results are tested and analyzed, and a conclusion is drawn, which verifies the feasibility of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Simulation of Dynamic Capacity Increasing Dispatching Model of Transmission Section Based on Fuzzy Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Under a certain section power flow lifting target, the capacity increase margin of each channel is obtained through the dynamic capacity increase calculation model. Considering the multiple risk security constraints of each load channel, a more reasonable capacity increase allocation scheme for each channel within the section can be obtained. Therefore, online continuous monitoring of the dynamic carrying capacity and residual load capacity of power cables can provide power system dispatchers with information about the available load capacity of cables, help system dispatchers to make more reasonable decisions in the future load distribution, and realize the dynamic capacity increase of power cables and the optimal utilization of cable resources. In this paper, the FNN (Fuzzy Neural Network) is used to measure the temperature of the outer sheath of power cables, realize the real-time cable load monitoring function, and provide the online calculation function of short-term allowable load. The dynamic capacity increase dispatching model can also maintain the global environmental information of multiple circuits. The specific method is to calculate the current limit for a single device through monitoring and measurement, and give the current limit of the load channel according to the "cask principle", and then obtain the capacity limit of the channel.

articleTitle: Topic Search Algorithm of Network Multimedia Educational Resources Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the increasing scale of multimedia educational resources on the Internet, it is difficult to quickly retrieve resources that meet your needs. In order to accurately search multimedia educational resources from web pages, this paper focuses on the topic search algorithm, and introduces artificial intelligence technology to design a topic search system for network multimedia educational resources to realize intelligent retrieval of resources. For the three proposed topic search algorithms, this paper evaluates the algorithm performance. The evaluation experiment results show that the HITS search algorithm has the highest precision rate and recall rate, and the Topic-PageRank algorithm is the lowest. For different types of educational resource topics, the HITS search algorithm still has the highest search accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Start-up and Debugging Method of Electrical Engineering Equipment Based on Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the improvement of the level of electrical engineering, the requirements for automation are increasing. As the most important equipment, it is necessary to pay attention to the debugging of related equipment to ensure the safety of equipment operation. At the same time, it is necessary to further strengthen the monitoring of equipment operation, realize the automation level of electrical equipment through new technologies, and achieve the development goal of electrical intensification and intelligence, so as to better promote the production quality of electrical equipment. Based on the investigation and analysis of traditional automatic debugging methods of electrical engineering, this paper puts forward an automatic startup debugging method of electrical engineering equipment based on Apriori algorithm, so as to better ensure the safety and stability of equipment operation. Through the research, it is found that the accuracy rate of the automatic start-up debugging method of electrical engineering equipment of this debugging method is higher than that of the traditional debugging method, and the highest accuracy rate of this debugging method can reach 95% in the detection process. While the traditional debugging method is only 63%. By comparing the results of error rate, we can also see that the error rate of this debugging method is obviously lower than that of the traditional debugging method. It can be seen that the debugging method in this paper has higher debugging effect than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Simulation of Hierarchical Fault Diagnosis Model for Aircraft Electromechanical Systems Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the growth of information technology, artificial intelligence technologies represented by machine learning and pattern recognition are gradually being applied in the field of fault diagnosis. Due the rapid growth of high-tech, the composition and structure of aircraft electromechanical systems have become increasingly complex. Traditional empirical methods have been difficult to solve some new problems that have emerged. Therefore, seeking fast and accurate fault diagnosis technology has become a new trend in the field of aircraft electromechanical fault diagnosis. Traditional manual troubleshooting is time-consuming and labor-intensive, with low diagnostic efficiency and accuracy. In recent years, machine learning has gradually gained popularity due to its efficiency and accuracy in artificial intelligence fault diagnosis. In response to the characteristics of frequent, difficult to eliminate, and time-consuming and labor-intensive maintenance of aircraft electromechanical faults in aircraft maintenance, this paper proposes the application of RMBP neural network to construct an intelligent diagnosis system for aircraft electromechanical faults. The data-driven machine learning analysis method has good engineering results. The results indicate that the intelligent diagnosis system for aircraft electromechanical faults can correctly diagnose the faults of test samples and meet the needs of aircraft electromechanical fault maintenance.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Smart Grid Information Scheduling Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Due to the rapid growth of smart grid, the application of power grid dispatching system has gradually developed from basic dispatching business to information business applications such as data fusion, heterogeneous system interaction and big data analysis. The overall development direction of power grid now and in the future is smart grid, and the application of relatively emerging cloud technology to power grid system can provide technical support for comprehensive and in-depth innovation of business model and operation mode of power grid enterprises to a certain extent. However, the current power grid dispatching system can not meet the requirements of big data analysis and other information services. Based on the theory of complex science, aiming at the development and preliminary planning of smart grid, this article analyzes the complex characteristics of smart grid management information system (MIS), and proposes a smart grid information scheduling algorithm based on deep learning. The results show that the system has good performance, and can effectively improve the business application level of the system and complete the corresponding scheduling.

articleTitle: Design of Equipment Automation Control and Remote Supervision System Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The automatic control system of electrical equipment is closely related to its production and operation, so the system must have high fault tolerance and reliability. The key to effectively improve the reliability of the system lies in the redundant fault-tolerant technology. How to introduce this technology into the industrial furnace control system and prevent paralysis and collapse in order to improve the reliability of equipment operation is worthy of in-depth exploration. This time, based on AI (Artificial Intelligence) algorithm, the automatic control and remote supervision system of equipment is designed. The results show that there is still a big error between the given value and the measured value. The measured value of the given value can reach above 0.22, and the measured value fluctuates greatly, ranging from 0.12 to 0.37. In this regard, it is necessary to detect whether each measuring point has exceeded the limit, and the stability of each parameter also means the stable operation of the system. By combining with AI algorithm, the efficiency of equipment automation control will be greatly improved to some extent, and the time consumed in traditional equipment control will be saved, so as to realize the whole process supervision and management of equipment production, operation and energy consumption.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Geographic Information Data of Three-dimensional Digital Aerial Surveying Image Technology in Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the advent of the 5G era, 3D digital design has been put on the agenda. Three-dimensional digital design technology is based on high-precision images, DEM, geographic information and other data, and relies on three-dimensional refined models to integrate the topographic and geomorphic information and construction process data of the power system transmission line corridor. Provide services for the survey and design, construction, digital handover, operation and maintenance of transmission lines. We build a real three-dimensional on-site environment to achieve optimized design, reduce investment, facilitate construction, and save operation and maintenance costs.

articleTitle: MEMS Array Voiceprint Imaging Algorithm and System Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As the key equipment of the electric power supply, safe and stable operation of power transformers have a significant impact on the operation of a large-scale electric power supply. The voiceprint monitoring based on MEMS sensor arrays can detect and diagnose the overall mechanical faults of power transformers which can be installed externally. It could be widely applied in online monitoring of transformer operation status. This article designs the MEMS sensor array algorithm, which is called Beam-Forming Algorithm, to detect the voiceprint directions and voice types. And further more, AI LSMT algorithm is used to analyze the signals of MEMS sensor arrays which is in time sequence. With the industrial voiceprint databases, LSMT algorithm can correctly distinct the power transformer sub-optimal health working status. The experiments show that with BFA and AI LSMT algorithm, abnormal working conditions can effectively be detected and monitored. Therefor, this MEMS array based voiceprint imaging equipment can provide early warning effectively and timely, which has much important application value for electric power supply.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Conductive Fiber Network Based on Information Fiber and Its External Field Response Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Conductive polymer composites are made of polymer matrix filled with conductive fillers, which are widely used in automatic temperature control heating materials, sensors, electromagnetic shielding, antistatic materials, etc. Under the action of stress, temperature, gas, liquid and other external fields, it shows rich response behavior. Although CPCs-based stress sensitive materials have excellent characteristics (such as easy processing and low cost), there are still many shortcomings to be solved. Therefore, it is of great significance to construct a new polymer structure to control the performance of CPCs. In order to obtain a more effective conductive network and improve the sensitivity, response rate and stability of composite sensor, CPC with different microstructures was prepared by designing and regulating the conductive network in CPC, the response behavior of CPC to external stimuli was discussed, and the relationship between the structure regulation and performance of CPC was analyzed.
