As a functional polymer material, it shows obvious response behavior to external stimuli such as temperature, humidity, organic solvents, pressure, etc., which provides great potential for the application of polymer materials in medical health, intelligent machines, aerospace and other fields.

articleTitle: Carbon Emission Prediction of Power Industry Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Long and Short Term Memory Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The power industry is one of the main sources of carbon emissions, and accurately predicting its carbon emission values can effectively promote China’s carbon peak target. This paper uses coal-fired power plants as its research object and suggests a carbon emission prediction model (PSO-LSTM) that uses particle swarm optimization to tune the long- and short-term memory hyperparameters of the LSTM neural network. The PSO technique successfully identifies the global optimal solution for LSTM model hyperparameter optimization, addressing the problem that it is challenging to select the best solution for LSTM hyperparameter, and continuously trains to identify the right hyperparameter and verify it. Experimental analysis was conducted on actual case data, and compared with traditional LSTM neural network prediction models, support vector regression (SVR), logistic regression (REG), and gated recurrent unit (GRU) models. The average absolute percentage error (MAPE) was 7.86%, verifying that this method has better prediction performance. The experiment shows that this carbon emission model has good accuracy and stability.

Author Keywords: Long and short term memory neural network

articleTitle: Research on the construction of smart transportation system based on the double-difference digital twin technology test model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the demand for intelligent transportation, the integration of urban transportation with network and information continues to deepen, and urban transportation is constantly combined with artificial intelligence. The digitalization of urban traffic and the intelligence of smart urban traffic will change the existing production methods. The digitalization and intelligence of urban transportation is the development trend of future smart urban transportation. Digital twin technology based on double differential is an important way to realize the digitization and intelligence of smart city transportation system facilities. The in-depth application of digital twin technology in smart city transportation can evaluate whether urban transportation construction is reasonable, and it can make overall planning of urban transportation construction plan. Based on the virtual model simulation and verification of the smart city traffic data interaction and operation of the physical system, precise real-time control of the smart city traffic construction process is carried out. A virtual digital urban rail transit and urban expressway operation system established by smart urban transportation based on double differential digital twin technology.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Apriori Algorithm Based on Big Data Analysis and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the development of the era of big data, data information is used more and more in life, and the application of data analysis is more and more extensive. The algorithm of data mining and association analysis are to find some internal relations in a large number of data sets. Although big data has brought abundant information and knowledge, its complexity in scale, rapid growth, diversity in forms and low value density have also brought severe challenges to traditional data processing technology. Therefore, there is an urgent need for big data processing technology to adapt to the big data environment. Based on the analysis of association rules and the principles of the Apriori algorithm, this article proposes an improved algorithm for improving the performance of the Apriori algorithm in the case of large data volumes, in order to address the drawbacks of the system's I/O load and CPU computational pressure caused by the large number of transactions when the Apriori algorithm scans the database. Using the Apriori algorithm to study the association rules of these data, in order to conduct reasonable analysis of the correlation between the data. Thus, the product interest set corresponding to the user's personality can be excavated. Realize the accuracy of individual product recommendations and bundled product recommendations, enhance the influence of the client, stimulate consumer purchasing desire, and achieve maximum profit.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of E-Commerce Logistics Terminal Distribution System based on Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent years, the express logistics service industry has always maintained a rapid development speed. At the same time, there are also problems such as scattered industry resources, fragmented services, malicious competition between companies, high costs and so on. This paper mainly studies the optimization design of e-commerce logistics terminal distribution system based on simulated annealing algorithm. This paper first introduces the concept of simulated annealing algorithm and analyzes the specific steps of simulated annealing algorithm. Then, this paper uses genetic algorithm to improve the simulated annealing algorithm. By combining the advantages of the two algorithms, the search ability of the solution becomes stronger and the time is short. At the same time, it gets rid of the dependence on the initial solution, avoids the “premature” phenomenon of the solution, and makes the optimization result more accurate. By using the improved simulated annealing algorithm to simulate the logistics end distribution, we can know that the efficiency of the improved simulated annealing algorithm is 7.6% higher than that of the simulated annealing algorithm.

articleTitle: Application of Cloud Collaborative Computing Model in the Design of Electric Power Communication Information Security Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As the technical support system of power grid dispatching command, data information transmission and intelligent substation construction, electric power urgently needs to plan and build a perfect, integrated, automated and unified data center basic platform. And promoting the research and innovation of cloud computing can accelerate the process of information construction, and then enhance the level of industrialization. With the goal of minimizing the average delay of the system, by introducing a continuously variable partition coefficient of cloud and edge tasks, the delay optimization problem is transformed into a convex optimization problem, and finally an optimized task partition strategy is obtained. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional grid data processing method based on cloud center architecture, this method improves the speed of data processing, and at the same time avoids the delay of data uploading and waiting for data return, thus achieving a quick response to data. Properly loading the tasks of edge nodes into the cloud center can effectively reduce the system delay of power business and alleviate the network congestion.

articleTitle: Research on Planning of Ordering and Transportation based on Multi-model Prediction and Heuristic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: To focus on the specific problems on the ordering and transportation of raw materials in production enterprises, this paper gives the main indicators to ensure the production of enterprises, establishes a TOPSIS evaluation model based on AHM weighting, determines the minimum number of suppliers, formulates an economical raw material procurement scheme and a transportation scheme with the least loss, and provides suggestions for enterprises to reduce costs and improve work efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on logistics optimization and development strategy of e-commerce platform based on NSGA-II
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the e-commerce industry, logistics has become an indispensable key link on the e-commerce platform. However, the current logistics scheme has problems such as low efficiency and high cost, which need to be optimized and improved. To solve these problems, this study proposes a logistics optimization method based on NSGA-II. First, we established a mathematical model of the logistics system of the e-commerce platform, taking into account various key factors, including order quantity, commodity category, transportation distance, etc. Then, we use the NSGA-II algorithm for multi-objective optimization with the goal of maximizing logistics efficiency and minimizing costs. In the experimental part, we conduct simulation experiments based on a real e-commerce platform dataset, and the results show that the optimization method based on NSGA-II can significantly improve logistics efficiency, reduce costs, and achieve a balance among multiple objectives. This study proposes a logistics optimization method for e-commerce platforms based on NSGA-II, which is of great significance for improving the logistics efficiency and development of ecommerce platforms.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Digital Substation Integrated Automation System Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Digital substation is composed of intelligent primary equipment and networked secondary equipment in layers. Based on high-speed network communication platform, information sharing and interoperability among intelligent electrical equipment in substation can be realized through standardization of digital information. Digital substations are undergoing comprehensive automation transformation, and the secondary system is replaced by comprehensive automation system, so as to enhance the automatic control function of substations and meet the monitoring requirements of power grid for substations. In this paper, the digital substation integrated automation system is designed and optimized based on improved GA, and through simulation experiments, the comparison experiments of three algorithms show that although the three algorithms are all shorter than the task completion time before optimization, it can be clearly seen that the algorithm in this paper performs better, is more suitable for digital substation integrated automation system, and is conducive to the rapid processing of tasks. The design and optimization of digital substation integrated automation system based on GA is of great theoretical value and practical significance to the safe operation of power grid.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Routing Algorithm Based on Fuzzy K-means Clustering of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In the application process of Internet of Things, the accuracy of user information obtained has great influence on the final data mining results. As an effective carrier for sensing information, wireless sensor networks can fully utilize the advantages of the Internet of Things technology to establish unified network communication protocols and service support strategies that can simultaneously meet multiple needs. In order to evaluate the performance of the algorithm, the derivation and analysis of the optimal cluster head are simulated and verified, and the performance indicators such as clustering, the number of dead nodes and the life cycle of the network are simulated. The results show that compared with ANN (Artificial Neural Network) and GA (Genetic Algorithm), this algorithm saves more energy and has a longer network life cycle. It can be seen that the detection result of this algorithm is more accurate and its algorithm performance is better.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model of Power Industry User Satisfaction Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In the face of multiple indicators, the user satisfaction evaluation model of the power industry is easy to fall into the local optimal cycle, affecting the evaluation results, and designs a user satisfaction evaluation model of the power industry based on the improved ant colony algorithm. Combined with the electric power industry to satisfaction balance integral card dimension design, from the financial, customer, internal and development innovation, using network hierarchy analysis in multiple indicators, construct weight judgment matrix, complete the establishment of satisfaction evaluation index system, on the basis of the traditional ant colony algorithm of pheromone selection path probability calculation and pheromone dynamic update mechanism improvement, avoid optimal algorithm in the process of iteration. In the model performance test, the historical data of a power company is selected as the experimental data set, and the designed model and the traditional model are tested respectively. The results show that the scoring error between the evaluation results obtained by the design model and the actual situation is smaller, which verifies the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: A Massive Resource Power System Operation Supporting System Adapting to Dual Carbon Goals
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In a bid to solve the power system operation support problem under the energy saving and emission reduction mechanism, a power system resource support system applicable to dual carbon targets is proposed. The requirements and influence of the dual carbon goals on the power system operation are analyzed, a power system operation analysis platform is proposed, combined with the power system operation process involving various forms of renewable energy, the optimization process of the VPP is analyzed. The overall flow framework of new energy grid-connected power generation is proposed, the power flow mode is analyzed, and the key technologies for the application of virtual power plants are explained.

articleTitle: Simulation Modeling of Whole-process Material Management of Distribution Network Energy Engineering Based on Markov Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This paper builds a whole-process management system based on a computer big data algorithm for power system materials. The author uses the Markov algorithm to construct an inventory management model based on demand characteristics, taking the energy engineering material storage of the power distribution network as the research object. Inventory management and scheduling decisions for materials rely entirely on past observations. Finally, this paper conducts a simulation study on the optimization scheme of emergency material dispatching of power systems in areas affected by natural disasters. At the same time, the configuration of the system under various disaster conditions is verified. This paper verifies the effectiveness of this method in improving the scheduling of power resources through the simulation of the Markov method. The whole process management system of power materials proposed in this paper can quickly meet the dynamic management requirements of the power grid and materials.

articleTitle: Design of Detection and Assessment System for Electric Vehicle Charging Station Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the large-scale electric vehicle (EV) charging load connected to the power grid, EV charging stations have been widely used. Basic charging facilities are supporting facilities to ensure the convenience of EV travel and affect the growth of EV industry. When building a charging station, several performance indexes with different dimensions should be considered when selecting a charging station. At present, a large quantity of EV charging stations have been built and operated all over the country, and most of them are unattended. In order to maintain the normal operation and use of the charging station, great attention should be paid to the detection and operation maintenance. In this article, aiming at the abnormal state in the detection of DC charging station, the phenomenon and reasons are analyzed, and the detection and assessment model of EV charging station based on genetic algorithm optimized neural network (GANN) is proposed, and the operation state of charging station is analyzed to complete the fault diagnosis. The simulation results show that the assessment model is highly robust and the assessment results are more objective, so that the operation and maintenance strategy of charging stations can be put forward, the performance and safety problems of charging equipment can be solved, and the sustainable growth of EV industry can be promoted.

articleTitle: Construction of an Intelligent Library Book Management System Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As a node of distributed information resources in the entire Internet, libraries continuously expand, extend, and improve their service space, time, and functions. In the library, the books that readers want to borrow must be scanned one by one using a barcode scanner before being lent out, which is tedious and inefficient. At present, AI has been applied in many aspects of library and information work, such as classification, cataloging, indexing, circulation management, information retrieval, etc. This article constructs an intelligent library book management system using AI (Artificial Intelligence) algorithm, and experimental results show that the accuracy of user borrowing times can reach 92% through data analysis of user borrowing times and average borrowing time. The average borrowing time accuracy is 87%. It can be seen that the accuracy of this method is due to the other two methods. The time and cost involved in data preprocessing are of utmost importance in improving the efficiency of data preprocessing. It can be seen that applying AI algorithms to library construction and library and information management, and developing intelligent library and information technology, is an important research direction for library development and construction.

articleTitle: Research on Three-dimensional System of Career Planning Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the progress of society and the development of science, especially the rapid development of computer technology and digital technology, people pay more and more attention to the digital technology of three-dimensional objects. Three dimensional digital technology can be widely used in machinery manufacturing and design, ergonomic measurement, clothing design, medicine, cultural relics protection and other fields. For 3D digital system, the mapping relationship between real world 3D information and computer virtual world information is realized through calibration. Calibration technology is the most key technology in 3D digital technology. The convergence of BP neural network has been widely concerned. The traditional three-dimensional stereo vision measurement technology based on the principle of triangulation will bring in the nonlinear error of imaging distortion. This new method can eliminate the influence of nonlinear factors. The sinusoidal function is used as the transfer function to speed up the training speed of the network and improve the learning accuracy. The results of spatial point position and size measurement verify the feasibility of the method. For different digital systems, the research on various calibration methods is a hot spot. Moreover, in order to realize the visualization of real color model of object, the matching of color information and spatial three-dimensional information is also the research content of calibration technology.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Recommendation System of New Media Short Video Based on Local Random Walk
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid expansion of network information and resources, users are faced with the difficulty of screening the information they need from massive data. It is necessary to find an effective tool or method to help users complete this information screening process. The core of the new media short video recommendation system is the short video recommendation algorithm, which predicts users' tendency to short videos based on their behavior records and the characteristics of short videos. Under this background, personalized recommendation algorithm came into being. Aiming at the sparseness and cold start of existing recommendation methods, a short video recommendation method is generated by random walk based on short video tags. Random walk is the research method adopted in this paper. It controls the depth of random walk and tries to select the rating information of the neighboring users who are close to the target users in the trust network. According to the research in this paper, the recommendation results generated by random walk method have better ranking quality than traditional algorithm data sets. Generally speaking, the ranking quality of random walk is higher than other methods.

articleTitle: Optimal Simulation Design of Mobile Communication Attenuation Model Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The main purpose of mobile communication attenuation model is to optimize the network equipment of operators and the types of actual services through theoretical simulation calculation. In this paper, the attenuation model of mobile communication is studied based on ACA (Ant Colony Algorithm). Ant travel only takes place in one direction and may be delayed in congested nodes. The role of an ant when it reaches a certain node will decrease with the increase of the age of the ant. According to the characteristics of different test environments, different simulation methods are given, and the influence of some important factors on signal transmission is emphatically simulated and analyzed. The simulation results of path loss in outdoor to indoor walking environment show that the path loss increases rapidly from 80db to 125db in the first 900mm. Moreover, the outdoor path loss is slightly larger than that indoors, because there are abundant outdoor shelters, especially those obstacles such as trees and vehicles on the path will have a certain impact on the logarithmic normal shadow fading. It can be seen that this method improves the accuracy of the predicted attenuation value and provides a more accurate prediction model for the optimization of mobile communication air interface network.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Workshop AGV System Scheduling System Based on Intelligent Fuzzy Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: AGV trajectory tracking is achieved by designing a control method that enables AGV to run along a pre planned curve trajectory, thereby achieving precise tracking. When the distance between the AGV and the dynamic obstacle is less than the safe distance value, the AGV needs to stop. When the distance is greater than this value, the AGV needs to be restarted to continue driving. This can cause the AGV to stop when it exists, reducing the production efficiency of the enterprise. This article conducts research on the application of multiple AGV in digital intelligent manufacturing workshops. In response to the high complexity and nonlinearity of the AGV dynamic model, this paper adopts an intelligent fuzzy control algorithm to achieve AGV trajectory tracking control. The controller is designed with pose deviation as input, ultimately enabling the algorithm to play a role in obstacle avoidance behavior decision-making. The results show that the intelligent fuzzy controller can enable AGV to quickly track the path, smoothly correct deviations, and have good tracking and correction capabilities. A series of experiments and simulation analyses were conducted based on the path planning and scheduling model mentioned earlier, verifying that the scheduling method proposed in this paper is more suitable for practical applications.

articleTitle: Research on Condition Monitoring Technology of Modular Reactive Power Compensation Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this paper, an intelligent modular RPC (Reactive power compensation) system state monitoring system is established. According to the running state data of the modular RPC control system collected by the distribution transformer terminal information collection system; A comprehensive state evaluation model of modular RPC control system based on Bayesian network is established. In the evaluation, the model deals with the problems of over-compensation and under-compensation, frequent switching and control sensitivity of modular RPC control system. Based on Java platform, the state monitoring software of modular RPC control system is designed and developed. It is found that the error between the monitoring system and the standard power quality meter is less than 1%, so it can be considered that the three-phase voltage data monitored by the three-phase basic electrical parameter monitoring module is accurate. It can realize comprehensive on-line monitoring of the running state of modular RPC control system.

articleTitle: Dynamic Reactive Power Optimization of UHV New Energy Power Network Based on QGA
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: At present, the proportion of new energy connected to the grid is constantly expanding, and the voltage stability margin of AC/DC power grid is greatly reduced, and the voltage stability control ability of UHV DC power grid is low. In view of the above problems, this paper carries out research on dynamic reactive power allocation strategy of UHV power grid with a large number of new energy sources at the transmission end, and proposes a dynamic reactive power optimization strategy based on quantum genetic algorithm. Firstly, the sensitivity analysis of AC/DC hybrid system is carried out to determine a dynamic reactive power allocation evaluation index that comprehensively considers the steady-state and transient characteristics; Then, the dynamic reactive power model of UHV new energy grid based on this index is established to realize dynamic reactive power optimization; Finally, the strategy is applied to the actual power grid, and the calculation shows that the strategy is practical and effective.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Control System for Garden Irrigation Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: AI (intelligence algorithm) can identify the optimal irrigation path by data training, clustering and other methods, which can effectively save water resources. With the maturity and wide application of AI neural network algorithm, irrigation and fertilization for crop growth will develop towards precision and dynamics. In this paper, an automatic control system of garden irrigation based on AI algorithm is proposed. An improved GA (genetic algorithm) is proposed, and FNN (Fuzzy neural network) controller is designed to realize the optimal design of fuzzy control rules. By introducing fuzzy coding method to express the structure of fuzzy neural controller, the task of parameter optimization is greatly reduced and the operation of GA is accelerated. The results show that the proposed FNN has smaller error and higher fitting degree in the prediction of crop evapotranspiration. The irrigation time can be calculated by the predicted irrigation water demand. Simulation results show that the algorithm is reasonable and effective. The optimization algorithm in AI is applied to the traditional FNN to reduce the error and improve the accuracy of the model, and it is successfully implemented in garden irrigation control.

articleTitle: Construction of Supply Chain Financial Information Flatform Based on “Blockchain + Internet of Things”
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As an important area of blockchain technology application, the supply chain has played a significant role in promoting the development of small and medium-sized micro enterprises. This article will start from the development of “blockchain + Internet of Things” technology and supply chain finance, and establish a trustworthy information sharing platform, which is composed of authorization management module, credit management module, smart contract module and traceability management module, so as to share supply chain information, financial information and regulatory information, and ensure the authenticity and reliability of information. At the same time, it provides its corresponding information query function for each subject, simplifies the cumbersome paper review and credit granting links, and greatly reduces the risk of supply chain finance.

articleTitle: Construction of Doubt Prediction Model of Audit Big Data Based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In order to support the formulation of audit plan with scientific data, an audit doubt prediction algorithm based on parallel improved random forest algorithm is proposed under the background of audit big data. Firstly, a Hadoop-based audit big data management scheme for electric power enterprises is established, and the heterogeneous audit data collected by various power grid subsystems are integrated and stored. With the advent of the era of big data, the geometric growth of audit data and the increasing complexity of data types have brought great challenges to the audit work, and the traditional sampling audit and query-based audit methods can no longer meet the requirements of “full audit coverage”. This paper combines theory with practice, uses big data analysis methods such as k-means++ clustering analysis and text mining in financial internal audit to help determine audit priorities, find audit doubts, improve audit efficiency, provide technical basis for full coverage of audit supervision, and provide solutions for the development of large data internal audit, which has certain theoretical significance and practical value.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Fault Detection and Location Algorithm for Power System Based on Wavelet Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In power system, system faults usually reflect abrupt changes in voltage and current signals, and timely and accurate detection of these abrupt signals is a prerequisite for reliable operation of relay protection devices. The distribution line is the terminal line directly connected to the users, and the fault point can be quickly located after the distribution line fails, which can improve the reliability of power supply for users. WT (wavelet transformation) is a widely used signal processing method in recent years, which has time-frequency localization performance. The main purpose of this paper is to study the intelligent detection and location algorithm of power system faults, and give a diagnosis and location method of power system faults under the fusion of electrical information and switching information by WT and BN (Bayesian network). Based on WT theory, the electrical information of fault information is decomposed and reconstructed, and the fault features are extracted. The comprehensive feature information is input into the trained BN for reasoning, so that the fault diagnosis and location can be realized. The simulation results show that the algorithm effectively improves the calculation process and accuracy, and improves the integrity of fault signal detection and location based on the complementarity of information composed of electrical quantities and switching quantities.

articleTitle: Identification of Mine Rock Stratum Movement Model Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Due to frequent coal mine accidents, the topic of mine safety monitoring has attracted more and more attention of coal mine enterprises. On the basis of dynamic monitoring of mine strata movement, it is of great guiding significance to analyze and study its movement law for safety control of mining engineering and disaster prediction. In this paper, the basic principle of mine safety detection, pre-alarm and integrated management system is discussed. Under the condition that the function form is not predetermined in advance, the improved genetic algorithm (GA) is used to gradually obtain a high fitness model through population reproduction and evolution, thus revealing the inherent law of mine rock movement more accurately. After many iterations, the error of this method has obvious advantages over the comparison algorithm in monitoring the movement of mine strata, and the error is reduced by more than 30% compared with the comparison algorithm. Therefore, it is of great significance to apply this method to mine strata movement monitoring and mine safety pre-alarm. The main purpose of this study is to analyze the movement of mine strata and the prevention and control technology of mine geological disasters, and strive to effectively improve the prevention and control level of mine geological disasters.

articleTitle: Detection and Fine Positioning of Basketball Technical Characteristic Target Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Athletes' movements are irregular, their postures will change in the process of movement, and the colors of athletes and scenes may be similar. At present, the research on basketball technical feature target detection is divided into two situations: moving target detection in static background and moving target detection in dynamic background. In this paper, based on DL (Deep Learning) algorithm, the detection and fine positioning of basketball technical feature targets are studied. It is found through experiments that the larger the convolution sum is, the higher the accuracy of the model is. Moreover, due to the advantages of small convolution and recalculation, the training time will be shortened. Satisfactory experimental results can be obtained, and moving targets can be detected effectively. The experimental results show the effectiveness and relative superiority of adaptive background updating method in moving target detection. The size and position of the basketball target are located by DL algorithm. The algorithm in this paper has the advantages of simple and effective implementation, and the algorithm can still locate the basketball target accurately when there is a slight split.

articleTitle: Research on the Drop Point Distribution of Conductive Fiber Bundles Based on Microfluidics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The attack on power system facilities in wartime will greatly affect the progress and outcome of the war, and the importance of its safety protection is negligible. In order to study the scattering law of conductive fiber tow based on micro-fluidic, according to the external ballistic theory of submunition throwing and the movement characteristics of tow spreading and falling, and focusing on the influence of the scattering speed of tow on its landing point, an external ballistic model of tow from throwing to landing was established. Aiming at the influence of wind speed, wind direction, initial throwing speed and other factors on the spreading and falling process of conductive fiber tows in the air, the force analysis of the spreading and falling process of the conductive fiber tows in the air was carried out, and a mathematical model describing the spreading law of the tows was established. The dispersion results of conductive tow landing points obtained by this model are basically consistent with the flight test results in the shooting range, and can be used to predict the overall dispersion of tow landing points in practical applications. When the simulation times are more than 50 times, the average values of dispersion radius and dispersion center coordinates tend to be stable.

articleTitle: Design of Massive Data Management System Based on DBN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the network, the World Wide Web has become the carrier of a large amount of information, which contains a lot of valuable information, and its great potential can not be underestimated. At present, both at home and abroad are paying attention to the potential business opportunities brought by big data, and all walks of life have their own potential business data to achieve the greatest commercial profits in the market. At present, data processing technology in storage system has its own advantages, but it also has its own shortcomings in large-scale data processing. This article takes a large-scale transaction processing system as the research platform, and designs and implements a massive database monitoring and management system to address the main problems in massive database monitoring and management. The system architecture, running model, module design, and key technologies involved are included. Then, using labeled data, the algorithm based on L-BFGS is used to fine tune the system model. At the same time, in order to avoid overfitting, the drop out method is introduced in the pre training and fine tuning process. The experimental results using five fold cross validation and different scale datasets show that the proposed classification method outperforms KNN, SVM, and BP algorithms, and the classification results are relatively stable.

articleTitle: Parallel Calculation and Simulation of Urban Rail Transport Train Operation Based on GA
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Urban rail train is one of the main modes of transportation in modern cities, and the calculation of train operation is an important work in the design of urban rail transport system. A good design of the train running process is the basic requirement to better meet the transportation demand and manage the rail transport system. This paper mainly studies the automatic adjustment method based on genetic algorithm (GA) when the actual train diagram of urban rail transport deviates from the planned train diagram. Based on the train dynamics theory, the train running time is divided into constraints, and the improved GA is used to establish a single train energy-saving operation control model. By reasonably grouping urban rail trains, the regenerative braking energy utilization is transformed into the time overlapping problem between the braking trains and other accelerating trains in the group. By improving the GA, the working condition sequence of the trains in the group is searched and optimized, and a multi-train energy-saving operation scheduling scheme is established.

articleTitle: Design of Fluid-Structure Coupling Difference Iterative Algorithm for Simply Supported Beam Pipeline Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the value of big data has attracted more and more attention. How to analyze big data efficiently has become an important issue. Machine learning is one of the common methods for data analysis. Traditional machine learning algorithms are often designed as offline batch training. However, this method is difficult to apply to the massive and growing data sets in the big data environment. In this paper, the simply supported beam pipeline and the fluid-structure coupling difference iterative algorithm are comprehensively analyzed and calculated by machine learning survey method. The results show that the convergence and stability criteria of machine learning algorithm for nonlinear high-order difference equations are complex, and there are often more than three layers of difference grids, at which time the difference is 53.44% of the multi grid ratio. Therefore, the iteration of finite difference method has a significant impact on the convergence of machine learning algorithm. Finally, combined with the actual pipeline circulation system, the feasibility and significance of the model and algorithm based on machine learning in calculating complex pipeline system are verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Robot Inspection Path Planning in Substation Based on Artificial Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Based on ANN (artificial neural network), this paper puts forward an inspection path planning algorithm for substation robots, which combines BPNN (BP neural network) with nonlinear fitting and prediction ability with reinforcement Q learning algorithm with strong online learning ability. Firstly, the running environment of the robot is described and the environment type is determined. Secondly, given the state space description and action space description of the mobile robot, the input and output parameters of BPNN are determined. Then, the rules of obstacle avoidance for mobile robots are established, so that they can quickly jump out of the shock trap. The simulation results show that the convergence speed of the proposed algorithm is faster than that of APF (Artificial potential field) method, and the numerical value after convergence is stable and the fluctuation of the optimal solution is small. Moreover, both the path distance and the number of turns are superior to APF algorithm. It shows that the method proposed in this paper can help the inspection robot to traverse the inspection points and avoid collision targets.

articleTitle: Construction of Strong Electricity Construction Quality Control System for Building Electrical Installation Based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As a functional construction project, the building electrical installation project involves a wide range, and it has obvious characteristics of technicalization, complication, link and systematization. Once the building electrical installation project is actually constructed, some construction quality problems will occur in some links. In this paper, the construction of quality control system for strong electricity construction of building electrical installation based on fuzzy clustering algorithm is proposed. In this paper, the FCM (fuzzy c-means) algorithm in fuzzy cluster analysis is used to divide the measured data into suspicious data and reliable data, and form the initial classification matrix and the membership matrix of each classification matrix. The FCM algorithm is used to iteratively optimize the membership matrix of suspicious data and reliable data, so as to realize fuzzy clustering of measurement data and obtain the membership degree of good data measured by each quantity. The results show that the qualified rate of quality inspection after the implementation of the activity is 97.01%, which is 1.16 percentage points higher than the previously set target value of 95.85%. At the same missing rate, the filling accuracy decreases with the increase of missing attributes. The missing rate is 1.03%, and the filling accuracy is higher than 59.36%. It can be seen that the filling accuracy of multi-attribute missing values is higher when the missing rate is low.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Semantic Checking Algorithm of Article Editing Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a semantic checking algorithm based on long-short-term memory neural network is proposed to solve the problem of word errors in article editing. To a certain extent, the algorithm solves the problem that the wrong words cannot be intelligently checked and prompted in the article editing work. The model trained according to the corpus of different topics can solve the problem of difficult word error correction in the editing of related articles. After analyzing the requirements of semantic inspection algorithms, this paper first designs and implements two word embedding algorithms in data processing, and then trains a language model based on long and short-term memory networks. Finally, after analyzing the test results of the model, the optimal semantic check effect. And realized the semantic checking algorithm based on neural network machine learning. This algorithm first collects, organizes and constructs a standard corpus data set; secondly, the word embedding algorithm is used to map the processed corpus data to the word vector space; finally, it is trained to identify sentence segments and analyze the sentence segments according to the results obtained by the word embedding algorithm.

articleTitle: Simulation of Signal Source Energy Attenuation Model Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As a platform for real-time acquisition, monitoring and processing of monitoring information, wireless sensor network (WSN) has one of its most basic functions, which is to obtain the node position. In the traditional target location algorithm, it is assumed that all node coordinates have been located and are accurate. However, in the actual WSN, the target location and tracking node position need to be realized by the corresponding node location algorithm. In order to realize the target location and tracking of WSN, this paper proposes a signal source energy attenuation model based on genetic algorithm (GA). Aiming at the shortcomings of existing algorithms based on signal source energy model, this paper proposes a signal source energy attenuation model based on GA, which effectively reduces the sampling range of nodes and improves the sampling efficiency to achieve more accurate positioning. Simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively shorten the positioning time, and the positioning accuracy is improved by about 15% compared with the traditional algorithm. In the location-based routing protocol, accurate location information helps to improve the routing between sensors, thus reducing the power consumption during data transmission.

articleTitle: Optimization of Power Supply Inventory Management Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Inventory management is an important part of enterprise operations. Effective inventory management can not only improve the operational efficiency of enterprises, but also significantly reduce the logistics costs of enterprises. The purpose of this paper is to study the optimization of supply inventory management based on IoT technology. Summarize domestic and foreign inventory management research, analyze the problems existing in traditional inventory management on this basis, study supply inventory management methods, and put forward improvement measures for existing inventory management processes based on Internet of Things technology. And optimize the existing energy consumption procurement inventory management process. A BP neural network reserve quantification model optimized by genetic algorithm is proposed. Then the model is introduced into the power supply inventory management system, and the prediction function of the optimal reserve quota of power materials is designed and empirical analysis is carried out.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Evaluation System for Lyrics and Songs Matching Based on Intelligent Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid improvement of the Internet, intelligent algorithms are used in various fields. In this paper, the intelligent optimization algorithm (IOA) is applied to the evaluation system for the matching degree of music lyrics. The intelligent evaluation system of the matching degree of lyrics and songs based on the IOA can more accurately evaluate the matching degree of the lyrics and songs. The purpose of this paper is to evaluate and test the music based on the IOA using the fire fly algorithm music lyrics matching degree intelligent system. Compared with the class scores, the results show that the intelligent evaluation system for the matching degree of music lyrics has been improved under the IOA.

articleTitle: Design of Adaptive Coordinated Control Algorithm for Inertia and Damping of Virtual Synchronous Generator based on Fuzzy clustering in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Microgrid is a small power generation and distribution system that organically integrates distributed power sources, loads, energy storage devices, AC converters, and monitoring and protection devices. As a result, large-scale renewable energy grid integration has brought many challenges to traditional power grids, mainly reflected in: loss of inertia and damping, changes in short-circuit characteristics, triggering harmonic resonance and subsynchronous oscillation, etc. In this paper, the VSG (Virtual Synchronous Generator) inertia and damping adaptive coordinated control algorithm based on Fuzzy clustering is designed in the microgrid. Research has shown that the inertia parameters are directly related to the oscillation frequency of the dynamic response, and there is no excitation inrush current in the distribution transformer during the startup process. This indicates that VSG has the pre magnetization function of boosting the distribution transformer from zero. However, due to the influence of the transformer manufacturing process, the harmonic content of the excitation current in the experiment is relatively high, further verifying the effectiveness of the algorithm in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Imbalanced Data Classification and Computing Methods Using Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In the current era of big data, all walks of life are transforming towards data-based operations. In this process, many scenarios often produce unevenly distributed data, which is often determined by the nature of the actual problem. Aiming at the problem of imbalanced data set classification, this paper proposes an improved Support Vector Machine model. After random sampling of most samples without replacement and sampling of minority samples with replacement to generate balanced training subsets, Support Vector Machine is trained to solve the problem of low accuracy of imbalanced data set prediction. Then we select the imbalanced data set on the public data set, and conduct an empirical analysis of our proposed scheme to verify the effectiveness of the improved Support Vector Machine model in solving the imbalanced data set classification problem from a relatively comprehensive perspective. The results show that the improved method proposed in this paper can significantly improve the classification performance of imbalanced data.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Integrated Circuit Layout Planning Model Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: It is of great significance to vigorously develop the integrated circuit industry and study the design and manufacturing technology of integrated circuits, which will strongly promote the rapid growth of China’s information industry and greatly promote the healthy growth of the national economy. With the continuous improvement of integration, traditional two-dimensional integrated circuits are facing challenges from many sides, such as the limitation of size reduction, chip power consumption, online interconnection and so on. Compared with the traditional two-dimensional circuit, the three-dimensional circuit has a special structure, and its layout design needs a new algorithm. In this article, an analytical strategy of heat transfer in three-dimensional integrated circuits based on genetic algorithm (GA) is proposed to build a layout planning model of three-dimensional integrated circuits. The simulation results show that the error of the algorithm is small and the accuracy is excellent, which can reach more than 95%. As the core technology of three-dimensional integrated circuit, through silicon vias (TSV) can realize the electrical connection between stacked devices, thus shortening the interconnection length, reducing the delay and power consumption, reducing the chip occupation area, and realizing high integration and heterogeneous chip integration. The related results are helpful to the optimal design of TSV.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Feature Extraction of Gearbox Bearing Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Under the condition of high-speed operation, the bearing fault will rapidly develop into a serious accident, which makes the fault diagnosis must be advanced. Therefore, it is very necessary to find a suitable method to suppress the interference of discrete frequency components and complex modulation phenomena in the frequency spectrum, so that the bearing fault characteristic components can be highlighted. In this paper, a fault feature extraction method of gearbox bearing based on improved GA (genetic algorithm) is proposed. For the fault feature extraction of rolling bearing, before amplitude demodulation analysis, the fault diagnosis result can be effectively improved by using GA to separate gear signal from bearing signal and further realize its fault feature extraction. Boltzmann strategy in SA (Simulated Annealing) algorithm is added to GA to form an improved GA, so as to improve the global search ability of GA. The research results show that compared with the traditional mathematical morphological spectrum analysis method, the improved mathematical morphological spectrum method proposed in this paper has better ability to distinguish vibration signals with different modulation frequencies, and is stable and time-consuming, so it is effective as a feature vector extraction method.

articleTitle: Design of Automated Warehouse System Based on PID Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Automated warehouse system is a system that can automatically store and take out materials without direct manual treatment. Compared with foreign developed countries, there is a big gap in the number and construction level of automated three-dimensional warehouses in China. This topic is mainly aimed at the design of automated warehouse system based on PID algorithm. This system can maintain daily information, and carry out corresponding inventory as needed, such as establishing, modifying and deleting information. The control strategy of motor speed of stacker in storage system is studied, and the PID control strategy is optimized by IPSO (improved particle swarm optimization) algorithm. Cosine adjustment is introduced into the inertia weight of traditional PSO algorithm, which improves the deficiency of traditional PSO algorithm that it is easy to fall into local optimal solution in the later stage. The simulation results show that the IPSO algorithm optimizes the PID control motor speed system, and the motor speed performance has been greatly improved compared with that before optimization. In this paper, IPSO algorithm has excellent anti-interference ability, so it gets the best PID tuning result, which is better than the standard PSO algorithm.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis and Prediction of Power Grid Equipment Production Cost based on Stepwise Pegression Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of transmission and distribution price cost supervision and review, support the high-quality operation of modern equipment management system, strengthen the lean management of power grid equipment production cost and improve the overall asset operation performance, power grid enterprises carry out lean management of production cost. This study aims to measure the cost input-output and makes a comprehensive evaluation of the cost input-output of a power grid company from the dimensions of assets, safety, benefit and efficiency by using the regression analysis method. Then the quantitative relationship between cost and key factors is established to predict the future cost, which effectively cope with the pressure of future cost changes.

articleTitle: Construction of Multi-objective and Multi-regional Power Grid Planning System Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Power grid planning is one of the important links in the power industry, and is an important prerequisite and guarantee for the economic and stable operation of the power grid. The development of electric power industry and the need of marketization put forward higher and higher requirements for power grid planning. In the process of future power grid development, the influence of various uncertain factors is essential. These uncertain factors will affect the forecasting results of power supply and load to a large extent, resulting in the inability to obtain accurate values. In this case, a multi-objective and multi region power grid planning model based on improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed in this paper to comprehensively analyze the random uncertainty and fuzzy uncertainty in power grid planning, and the corresponding mathematical model expression is given. The example shows that the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm can find the global optimal solution more quickly and effectively than the ordinary particle swarm optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: Simulation of Coordinated Optimization Model of Power Grid Energy Storage Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Although the development of new energy sources such as wind energy and solar energy has alleviated the demand for new energy sources in China to some extent, its large-scale grid connection has brought new challenges to the safe, stable and efficient operation of the power grid. Based on the independent operation of microgrid, this paper puts forward a coordinated optimization model of grid energy storage based on improved GA (Genetic Algorithm), and studies the method of optimizing the power distribution of hybrid energy storage system. The power multi-hysteresis control strategy is adopted to distribute the energy among the energy storage units reasonably. The improved GA is used to simulate the optimization model in this paper, and the output of each unit and the change of load sequence are simulated. The research results show that the utilization rate of thermal power units is greatly improved by using the mode of coordination between energy storage equipment and demand response. The simulation results show that the optimization scheme proposed in this paper is reasonable, which can provide positive auxiliary decision-making for economic dispatch and power transaction of distribution network system.

articleTitle: Design of Control Algorithm for I-ion Battery Pile Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The power source of electric vehicles mainly depends on power batteries, and the cycle life, capacity, charging and discharging time, self-discharge rate and power of batteries are the main performance indexes of electric energy vehicles. In general, in electric vehicles, the power drive requirements of electric vehicles are met by connecting batteries in series, and the voltage level is improved. However, the current method can’t guarantee the consistency of battery parameters such as SOC. In this article, a balanced control strategy of i-ion battery pile SOC based on PSO algorithm is proposed. The update strategy of global domain search and the learning mechanism of adding chaos interference and global optimal particles are adopted to overcome the shortcomings of traditional PSO algorithm, such as slow iteration speed and easy falling into local optimal value. And the simulation results show that the proposed balancing control strategy for i-ion battery pile not only balances the charging and discharging of the battery pile, but also improves the balancing structure and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Coordination and Interaction Optimization of Power Grid and Demand Side Electric Energy Considering the Differentiation Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the power optimization problem of power grid and demand side, a power optimization difference mechanism is proposed. The authenticity of electric energy data, the uniqueness of electric energy data, and the fairness of optimization environment are analyzed. A differential optimization model is established, and according to the classification principle of electric energy and data, the model indicators are further subdivided according to equipment, product added value, data service, auxiliary service and other contents. And it gives the rating of the differentiated service of the power grid during the operation of the main equipment. Finally, the differentiated service model established in this paper is analyzed and tested in aspects of the system security, high efficiency and technical characteristics, and the effectiveness of the proposed model is illustrated.

articleTitle: Design of Security Encryption Algorithm for Distribution Terminal Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Distribution automation is an important feature of smart grid and an important goal to be achieved in building smart grid. In order to improve the encryption ability and anti-attack ability of information output, it is necessary to combine arithmetic coding and encryption model to build a two-layer structure distribution terminal security encryption model. This paper presents a security encryption algorithm for distribution terminals based on ANN (artificial neural network). According to ANN model and symmetric encryption method, a symmetric encryption algorithm based on ANN can be constructed. Input the data or file to be encrypted into the neural network, and the neural network can quickly generate ciphertext data, and save the ciphertext data to the file or database to complete the data encryption. Input the data or file to be decrypted into the neural network, and the neural network can quickly generate plaintext data, and save the plaintext data to a file or database, and then decrypt the data. The research results show that the maximum encryption time and decryption time of the proposed algorithm are 16.521s and 9.869s, respectively. This algorithm does have a good performance in the process of encryption and decryption. In practice, the encryption and decryption time can be reduced to a lower level through better performance hardware devices or optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Map Matching Algorithm of Vehicle Navigation System Based on Remote Sensing Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Vehicle navigation system effectively combines vehicle manufacturing, service control and transportation, thus becoming a comprehensive transportation system that can improve efficiency, improve environment, ensure safety and save energy. In this paper, a map matching algorithm for vehicle navigation system based on remote sensing image processing is proposed. Using high-precision remote sensing image as the working base map, the relevant positioning information is obtained from the GPS receiver, and the positioning points are imported into the calibrated remote sensing image, and the road is extracted from the remote sensing image to realize map matching, so as to achieve the purpose of vehicle navigation. The research results show that the map matching algorithm of vehicle navigation system based on remote sensing image processing has a high accuracy of road selection. With the map matching algorithm proposed in this paper, the matching efficiency is high, the driving skills are also improved, and the corner of the vehicle becomes more stable. Simulation results show the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed learning algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Photothermal Integration Technology of Tropical Photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This paper mainly studies a tropical photovoltaic solar energy integrated integrated comprehensive utilization device, which is divided into U-shaped frame, support cylinder, placement frame, transparent glass and concentrator. The bottom of the transparent glass and the top of the concentrator are made of Adhesive paste, the transparent glass and the concentrating plate belong to the inner cavity of the frame, and the thermoelectric components are stably linked on one side of the bottom surface of the inner chamber of the frame, and the other side of the bottom surface of the inner chamber of the frame is stably linked with photothermal components The conversion device, which is placed in the middle of the bottom surface of the frame, uses a support block and is stably linked with a hot water collection pipe. This paper mainly involves the field of photovoltaic solar energy utilization technology. This tropical photovoltaic solar energy integrated overall comprehensive utilization device can make heating The water in the box is continuously circulated into the heat collecting tube to heat up, so that the light energy can be used to the greatest extent, and the user can also control the temperature change of the water after the heating box is heated, which is convenient for the user. The root is used according to the actual situation, which greatly improves the overall thermal energy efficiency and the overall benefit is high.

articleTitle: Design of Partial Discharge Monitoring Algorithm for Transmission Cable Based on Optical Fiber Sensing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Partial discharge will continuously corrode the insulation layer of cable, which will greatly reduce its insulation performance, thus causing cable operation failure and power failure. For some overhead lines close to buildings, these problems will bring great security risks to the lives and property of residents. By monitoring the partial discharge phenomenon of cable intermediate joint, the insulation condition of indirect joint can be judged in time, and the insulation defect can be found early, thus reducing the cable failure rate of distribution network. In this article, the monitoring algorithm of partial discharge in transmission cable based on optical fiber sensing technology is studied. By detecting the interference signals of adjacent weak fiber gratings, the frequency, phase and position of acoustic vibration signals of partial discharge in the middle joint of cable are obtained, so as to judge the strength and position of partial discharge. The simulation results show that the algorithm can demodulate the partial discharge signal of each cable intermediate joint accurately and quickly, and realize large-scale distributed real-time online monitoring. The algorithm can demodulate the partial discharge signal of each cable intermediate joint accurately and quickly, and realize large-scale distributed real-time online monitoring.

articleTitle: Simulation of Big Data Order-Preserving Matching and Retrieval Model Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Although the speed of big data processing can be effectively improved through advanced infrastructure such as cloud computing and supercomputing and parallel distributed processing means, it is extremely important to seek an accurate and fast matching and retrieval algorithm for improving the order-preserving matching and retrieval accuracy of big data applications. This article is based on the DL (Deep Learning) big data order preserving matching and retrieval model. By implementing a layer by layer initialization strategy for encoding, the stack style self coding neural network is initialized, and the activation state of the hidden layer neural unit is used as input for the next level. The DBN (deep belief network) with RBM (Restricted Boltzmann Machine) as the basic unit is trained. Based on the distribution of text themes and image feature vectors, big data ordering matching and retrieval are achieved. The simulation results show that for the same random data series, with the increase of pattern length, the number of matching results will gradually decrease, and the proportion of similarity calculation time to the overall time of the algorithm will gradually decrease. In multi-data retrieval, the proposed method shows the trend of more data and higher accuracy, which has obvious advantages.

articleTitle: Research on Variable Voltage-Constant Voltage Phased Pulse Charging Method for Lithium Batteries Based on Fuzzy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The charging process of lithium battery will be affected by many factors, and the conventional charging method does not fully consider all the influencing factors in the charging process of lithium battery, so it is generally difficult to achieve the optimal charging effect. In this paper, based on the research of conventional fast charging method, it is improved and a variable voltage-constant voltage phased pulse charging method is proposed. Through the optimized fuzzy controller to control it, the voltage deviation and the change rate of voltage deviation are input, and the charging current is output, a two-input and one-output fuzzy controller is designed. The simulation results show that no matter what the initial SOC of the battery is, the charging time and energy consumption can be improved by using the proposed variable voltage-constant voltage phased pulse charging method for lithium batteries based on fuzzy algorithm. The proposed method of step-by-step pulse charging of lithium battery with variable voltage and constant voltage based on fuzzy algorithm can obviously shorten the charging time compared with variable frequency pulse charging, which shows that the optimization of step-by-step pulse charging of lithium battery with variable voltage and constant voltage based on fuzzy algorithm can improve the charging time and charging life at the same time.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Evaluation Model of Maintenance Efficiency of Power Internet System Using Data Collection and Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this paper, through the application of computer Internet technology in the power system, the power Internet technology effectively improves the operation and maintenance efficiency of the power Internet system and effectively reduces the risks and failures of the power Internet application. The theme of the article is that it should be aimed at the application of the power Internet, and on this basis, research the IT infrastructure in the power system, and improve it through certain methods to effectively reduce the risk and failure rate in the power grid system. It can effectively analyze the data collected by smart devices to determine whether the power Internet application is healthy. The system has the ability to perceive risks in advance, and the application of this system can effectively improve the power Internet: application operation and maintenance efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Traveling Wave Fault Location of Transmission Lines Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Most transmission lines are exposed to the outdoor environment, especially cross-regional transmission lines, cross-mountains and rivers. Therefore, in the power system, transmission lines have the highest probability of failure in various components of the power system due to their working environment and other reasons. In this paper, based on PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization) algorithm, traveling wave fault location at both ends of transmission lines is studied. The simulation results show that the overall relative error of the network without ant colony algorithm optimization is very small, and the head-end error is large, basically within 9%, and the end-end relative error is slightly higher than the middle, basically within 5%. However, after optimization, the head-end error is within 8%, and the terminal relative error can also be controlled within 3%, which shows that the error after optimization is even smaller. The active identification of the precise time of the reflected wave head is realized by PSO algorithm, which greatly improves the reliability of ranging, while singular value decomposition has the advantage of accurately identifying fault signals and getting more accurate time parameters.

articleTitle: Power System Operation Optimization Process and Network System Design Based on Power Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the operation management problems of power generation, transmission, distribution, and electricity consumption, a power system operation optimization process and network system design scheme based on power big data are proposed. The article first analyzes the principles and application methods of electric power big data in the process of data collection and processing, puts forward the overall structure of data processing process according to the operation requirements of electric power system, designs the network deployment topology, analyzes the data transmission mechanism, and puts forward the integration with other systems. The big data optimization process of the power system in various links such as power generation, transmission, distribution, and consumption is analyzed, and specific application scenarios are put forward, and it is analyzed in combination with actual engineering cases.

articleTitle: Simulation Design of Intelligent Manufacturing System Architecture Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Intelligent manufacturing is a complex system engineering. Enterprises with different industries, different scales and different manufacturing modes have different modes to promote intelligent manufacturing. With the gradual rise of customized manufacturing, intelligent manufacturing system has been widely used. Intelligent manufacturing is increasingly becoming a major trend and core content of manufacturing development in the future. It is an important measure for enterprises to move towards the middle and high end and accelerate transformation and upgrading, and it is also an inevitable choice for enterprises to build competitive advantages under the new normal. This article introduces the basic principle and characteristics of GA (Genetic algorithm), and on this basis, based on the improved GA, puts forward an intelligent scheduling method, thus providing support for intelligent manufacturing system. The results show that compared with other methods, this method always needs the least quantity of iterations and running time. MAE can reach 1.06, which is lower than 1.67 of particle swarm optimization and 1.38 of ant colony optimization. This shows that the overall performance of this algorithm is good.
