In order to provide some new ideas for related fields and promote the transformation of traditional manufacturing enterprises to digitalization, networking and intelligence.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Monitoring System Based on Internet of Things in Intelligent Control and Management of Methanol Reforming Hydrogen Fuel Cell
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Fuel cells mainly use hydrogen, natural gas, methanol, etc. Due to the limitation of region, availability of hydrocarbon resources and other conditions, some users can't adopt the most economical hydrogen production technology of natural gas reforming, and instead use electrolysis and methanol hydrogen production technology. As a vehicle-mounted fuel, hydrogen has some disadvantages, such as poor safety, low storage efficiency and strict requirements for hydrogen storage devices. How to safely and efficiently produce hydrogen on-line is one of the key issues to solve the popularization and application of fuel cell vehicles. In this paper, a digital detection system based on the Internet of things (IoT) is proposed in combination with the dynamic power demand of the whole vehicle for fuel cells under actual working conditions. Through the localized processing and calculation of the data collected by the IoT, the problems can be analyzed in real time, which is used to assist the intelligent control of methanol reforming hydrogen fuel cells. For the fuel cell system for hydrogen production from methanol reforming on vehicle, a reasonable hydrogen supply management strategy can reduce methanol consumption and improve the efficiency of the whole vehicle system without affecting the vehicle power performance, the service life of core components such as fuel cell and power cell.

articleTitle: Construction of Network Security Situation Assessment Model Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Large national power grid enterprises such as State Grid and China Southern Power Grid have been continuously strengthening the construction of network security defense systems, but the existing defense systems mainly take countermeasures after an attack occurs, failing to take the initiative and predict and eliminate threats in advance. This article constructs a network security situation assessment model based on the improved ACA (Ant Colony Algorithm), which can comprehensively analyze various situation elements of network security and dynamically reflect the overall situation of network security. Simulation experiments show that the overall trend of network throughput of the three algorithms gradually decreases as the number of black hole nodes increases. This is because the increase in black hole nodes makes it increasingly difficult to maintain stable network routing, and the massive loss of data packets leads to a reduction in throughput. The development trend of network security is predicted through the network security situation assessment model, which provides important support for network security emergency response and active defense. Build a targeted network security situation assessment model to provide guidance for smart grid to actively defend against attacks.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Sports Training System Based on Information Fusion Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: At present, competitive sports has developed to a very high level, and further improving sports performance is more and more dependent on advanced science and technology. How to combine the two through information fusion technology to improve the overall performance and automatic calibration capability of the system has become one of the important research directions in the field of orientation systems in recent years. The original single sensor technology can no longer meet the requirements of modern technology development, so the multi-sensor information fusion technology that uses multiple sensors to collect data and fuse these data emerges as the times require. The magnetic compass can measure the absolute orientation of the carrier, and it is stable relative to time, but the orientation measurement value is easily disturbed by the external magnetic field. The General Administration of Sports of the People’s Republic of China organized a research group composed of sports schools of physical education colleges, and undertaken the teaching reform plan for the key construction of sports schools. Feature-level fusion refers to extracting features from the raw data provided by each sensor and then merging those features. On the whole, both at home and abroad, the research and practice in this field have just started, and we need to constantly improve our ideas and ideas. When the moving body runs near the mining area, the constant interference is difficult to avoid, so it will affect the azimuth accuracy of the combined system. However, if people lack professional guidance in sports, they can not achieve the role of strengthening the body, but may cause excessive exercise and damage their own body. An in-depth understanding of the relationship and influence between sports training and sports teaching in terms of principles and characteristics is of far-reaching significance for promoting China’s sports training and sports teaching. This paper mainly aims at the important role of information fusion technology combined with digital physical training in improving the quality of physical training for elite athletes. At the same time, it also predicts that digital physical training will become an important direction of physical training development.

articleTitle: Simulation of Network Security Situation Assessment Model Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: While the network has gained popularity, it has also been attacked directly or indirectly by some lawless elements’ current technical means. Network Security Situation Awareness (NSSA) system can collect the relevant factors that affect network security, and analyze and process them, so as to infer the future network change trend, which can help network administrators predict the network development trend and make relevant countermeasures in time to prevent it. In this paper, the assessment model of network security situation (NSS) based on machine learning algorithm is studied, and the support vector machine (SVM) method is proposed to improve the accuracy of NSSA. The optimized prediction model is used to predict NSS, and the optimal prediction value is obtained. Finally, its performance is simulated and tested. The test results show that with the increase of the number of experiments, the assessment accuracy of the model is stable at around 94% and tends to a stable state. By comparing the accuracy of ID3 algorithm with that of traditional neural network (NN) algorithm, the accuracy of the algorithm proposed in this paper is much higher than that of the comparison algorithm. The proposed method can improve the speed and accuracy of NSS assessment and prediction, which shows the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Research on New Power System Carbon Footprint Dispatching System Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the technical characteristics of the electricity market, this paper proposes a method of using computer data to conduct electricity market transactions. This paper innovatively designs the application and operation mechanism of carbon rights trading, and on this basis gives an implementation logic based on alliances. This paper proposes a mathematical model of carbon emissions trading and gives the corresponding trading model. Finally, an example is given to prove that the carbon rights trading mechanism and model proposed in this paper are correct and feasible.

articleTitle: A Method for Weak Edge Extraction of Complex Medical Images Based on Visual Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Since the advent of microscopes, the analysis of medical images has become an important method in medical research. The emergence of new imaging technologies and equipment, as well as the development of computer technology, have led to an increasing role and impact of medical image processing technology on medical research and clinical practice. This article conducts research on weak edge extraction methods for complex medical images based on visual sensors. Through the research results, it can be found that the edge detection operator used in this paper as a weight matrix parameter enhances the connection strength between edge pixels. From the results, it can be seen that the image edge details are complete, continuous, and clear. This proves the feasibility of the method proposed in this paper. From the perspective of edge detection, people not only need perfect detection performance but also require accurate edge positioning. The visual sensor proposed in this article provides an ideal and practical solution for weak edge extraction in complex medical images.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Intelligent Manufacturing Execution System Based on Artificial Intelligence and Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The traditional manufacturing system is a pyramid hierarchical structure, and its planning, scheduling and control are centralized and serial, which lacks flexibility and cannot adapt to the frequent adjustment of production organization mode and the dynamic change of product demand under the condition of global market competition. Aiming at the development trend of intelligent MES (manufacturing execution system), this paper introduces AI (artificial intelligence) and DT (decision tree) algorithms into intelligent MES, and establishes an intelligent MES optimization model based on AI and DT algorithms. An improved GA (genetic algorithm) based on LSTM (Long short-term memory) with improved fitness function is proposed to solve the production scheduling problem. Using C4.5 algorithm based on normal distribution, the construction time of classifier is effectively shortened. The experimental results show that the fitness value of the improved GA is 10.93% higher than that of the standard GA, which proves the optimization effect of the improved GA algorithm on the fitness function. The experimental results show that this method meets the basic requirements of intelligent MES. It can monitor enterprises in all directions and visually, and realize integrated enterprise management and control.

articleTitle: Digital 3D Design of Power Transmission and Transformation Project Based on Multi-source Geographic Information Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, digital 3D technology is gradually improving and has been applied to many fields. Three-dimensional technology is a brand-new digital, virtual and intelligent design platform, which is mainly based on three-dimensional space technology and connected with digital technology, and integrates the design information of various specialties. Digital 3D technology can improve the efficiency of power transmission and transformation engineering design, and shorten the cycle of power transmission and transformation engineering design. At present, digital 3D design technology has become the development trend in power engineering design industry. Therefore, this paper summarizes the connotation, core advantages and the importance of applying 3D design technology to power transmission and transformation projects. The 3D design of power transmission lines is closely related to geographical environment, and the work of route selection and optimization, channel cleaning, land acquisition and demolition, environmental impact assessment and water conservation, crossing and crossing, and treatment of bad geological sections of power transmission lines are highly dependent on high-precision engineering geographic information systems.

articleTitle: Construction of Communication Information Encryption Transmission System Based on Bayesian Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Communication not only brings convenience to people, but also produces information. Malicious intrusion programs continue to threaten the network security in the network, resulting in a great threat to the privacy of users and becoming a potential safety hazard. In order to protect the security of network communication information, it is necessary to encrypt the key of communication message information. Naive Bayesian classification is an effective machine learning algorithm, which has important applications in text detection and medical diagnosis. In order to improve the security and real-time transmission of network communication information, this paper proposes a real-time encrypted transmission system of network communication information based on Bayesian algorithm, which can efficiently realize safe and naive Bayesian training and classification on encrypted data. The simulation results show that with the increase of the quantity of experiments, the accuracy of this algorithm is stable at about 95%, and the real-time wavelength tends to be stable, which is 18.85% higher than the traditional algorithm on average. The proposed scheme not only protects the privacy of outsourced data sets, naive Bayes model, samples to be classified and classification results, but also effectively reduces the computation and communication overhead. This method improves the security of the network and provides an effective guarantee for the security and real-time performance of the wireless communication network.

articleTitle: Control System of Multi-function Grid-connected Inverter for Distributed Power Grid Based on Intelligent Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Nowadays, the global energy crisis and environmental pollution are becoming more and more serious. Making full use of clean and renewable energy such as photovoltaic and wind power is the inevitable trend of power grid development in the future. Microgrid, as an effective means of distributed power access to the power grid, has gradually attracted widespread attention. In the distributed power generation system, various renewable energy sources are generally connected to the medium and low voltage distribution network through inverters. There are various power quality problems in point of common coupling (PCC) due to the extensive use of nonlinear power electronic devices in modern distribution system and the small capacity and various types of loads of the distribution network connected with renewable energy. To solve the above problems, this paper first establishes the structure of the distributed inverter system and the mathematical model of the distributed inverter system under balanced and unbalanced conditions. The advantages and disadvantages of traditional control methods for distributed inverter systems are introduced, and a control method for multiple distributed inverter systems based on adaptive virtual impedance is proposed. The experimental analysis results show that the improved repetitive controller can achieve fast and accurate tracking of the reference current, and the multi-function grid-connected inverter based on the improved repetitive control algorithm has excellent power quality control ability.

articleTitle: Design of MPPT Control Algorithm for PV Powern System Based on Grey Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the world economy, traditional energy sources are gradually exhausted and environmental pollution is becoming increasingly serious. New energy sources have become one of the most decisive factors in the development of the world economy in the 21st century. Among them, photovoltaic cell is an important part of energy conversion, and its output characteristics are not only related to the load, but also affected by the external environment. In order to improve the photoelectric conversion efficiency, it is necessary to adopt the MPPT (MPPT) tracking strategy. PV powern is an effective way to make full use of solar energy. At present, most PV powern in China are allowed to run on the grid, which provides conditions for the future development of PV powern in China. The MPPT of photovoltaic cells affects the PV power, and the grid-connected control method of photovoltaic inverter is related to the stability of photovoltaic system. This article proposes to apply the grey clustering algorithm (GCA) to the control of PV powern systems in response. By comparing and analyzing the simulation results, it was verified that the control technology using GCA has good speed and accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Management Platform for Electric Valve by Calculation Information
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: This paper discusses the design concept of nuclear power plant electric valve performance management platform aiming at solving the technical management problems of nuclear power plant electric valve equipment. The valve performance management platform specifically includes four parts that are basic data module, valve diagnosis module, the performance evaluation module and the performance trend module. And according to the design characteristics of each module, the composition elements and functional design concepts of each module are elaborated in detail.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Recommendation Algorithm of Wenchuang Based on Association Rules Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The proposal of “Internet +” has brought reform impetus to the development of all walks of life in China. In the era of “brand determines destiny”, how cultural and creative products will make use of the convenience brought by the Internet for brand construction and cultivate strong brands will determine the ability of cultural and creative products to participate in international competition for a long time in the future. Cultural and creative products have the characteristics of spiritual experience, differentiation and personalization. Therefore, the construction of its marketing model should not only conform to the concept of cultural marketing, but also fully express consumers’ values, so as to cause consumers’ value resonance. This paper deeply analyzes the consumption of cultural and creative products in the era of Internet technology, and puts forward a personalized recommendation algorithm of cultural and creative products based on association rule mining. The algorithm uses multi-layer association rules to solve the sparsity and scalability problems in the current recommendation algorithm, and uses the multi-layer association rules to mine users’ preferences for goods, so as to provide new insights and ideas for the construction of cultural and creative product marketing and promotion platform in the Internet technology era.

articleTitle: Design of Current Limiting Optimization Control System for High Voltage Direct Current Circuit Breaker Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The HVDC (high voltage direct current) circuit breaker can isolate the fault line, so that the DC(direct current) power grid does not need to lock all converter stations when one line fails, and does not affect the normal operation of other lines. In order to improve the reliability and transmission capacity, and realize the interconnection of different regional networks, multi terminal HVDC transmission has become a research hotspot. In this paper, the influence of different capacitance values on the breaking time and the influence of different inductance values on the breaking time are simulated. On the whole, the DC breaking time decreases with the increase of capacitance, which is due to the decrease of oscillation frequency and increase of oscillation amplitude caused by the increase of capacitance. When the capacitance value is greater than 110, the local breaking time will increase. On the whole, the DC breaking time increases with the increase of inductance, which is due to the decrease of oscillation frequency and amplitude caused by the increase of inductance. Through the experimental comparison of the three algorithms, it can be clearly found that the PSO (particle swarm optimization) is in the optimal value. Based on the particle swarm optimization algorithm, the current limiting of HVDC circuit breakers is optimized, and the current limiting optimization control system of HVDC circuit breakers is established in this paper. The system reduces the SSO problem at the sending end of the additional control suppression of the instantaneous impulse voltage and current amplitude borne by power electronic devices into the minima optimization problem in the controller parameter design.

Author Keywords: High voltage direct current circuit breaker

articleTitle: Design of a New Distribution Network Fault Location and Diagnosis Algorithm Based on Multivariate Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The access of distributed power sources to distribution networks not only improves the reliability of power supply, but also has a negative impact on relay protection schemes. This has brought difficulty to fault detection and a significant workload to the search for fault points, resulting in prolonged power outages and damage to electrical equipment, seriously affecting power supply reliability. This paper proposes a novel fault diagnosis algorithm for distribution network lines based on multivariate data fusion. The fault location equation is derived from the matrix inversion lemma, which can be easily applied to any system with phase balance conditions. The algorithm has been tested through simulation experiments. Taking the actual positioning distance of 8 km as an example, for inter pole short circuit faults and single pole ground faults, the value of 1/S converges, ensuring good convergence while ensuring convergence speed. The positioning accuracy is independent of the fault type, fault location, and transition resistance values, and can ensure that the error is less than 1%. This method has high positioning accuracy and a wide range of applications. In the process of identifying fault segments, it is only necessary to transmit measurement information within the relevant region to the host, thereby reducing communication traffic and improving computing speed.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Reliability Evaluation Model of Electric Power Communication Network Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Electric power communication network is a network information system that uses wired or wireless transmission media to connect user nodes with network nodes to complete a specific information transmission function. The reliability of electric power communication network is a complex system engineering composed of many factors, and its own particularity determines that there are similarities and differences between its communication reliability and that of ordinary public networks. In this paper, based on PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization), the reliability evaluation model of electric power communication network is constructed. The factors affecting the reliability of electric power communication network are analyzed by PSO, and the relationship between the influencing factors is analyzed by entropy weight method, and the corresponding weights are determined. Finally, the final result of the reliability of electric power communication network is obtained by PSO. It meets the requirement of quantitative description of the change of model reliability with time and can reflect the reliability of the model. The correctness of the model is proved. This model can objectively simulate the variation law of actual network efficiency with time, and provides a feasible analysis method for network reliability evaluation. The results show the real-time quantitative change of this model.

articleTitle: Intelligent Sports Data Measurement Based on Multi Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Data fusion technology is an information processing discipline that just emerged in the 1990s, and its application range is very wide, while target tracking and recognition is still the most important subject of data fusion technology research. And with the development of sports research, it has become an inevitable trend to pursue the accuracy of intelligent sports data measurement. In order to obtain accurate sports data, motion capture technology is an important means to obtain sports data. For this reason, based on the systematic analysis of the current human motion modeling and simulation research methods, this paper proposes a multi-data fusion-based intelligent New ideas for sports data measurement. With the help of a variety of modern signal analysis and processing methods, the feature extraction and motion pattern classification of EMG signals in the process of human movement are studied in detail. Compared with the image-based method, the accuracy of sports target tracking is further improved. In order to meet the requirement of similarity retrieval from large-scale database, the similarity measure of different human body movements and postures is defined. Display and manage human movement data and evaluation results, so as to facilitate the storage and query of historical movement records.

articleTitle: A Mathematical Model of Sound Pressure Attenuation for Optimizing Distribution of Orchestra Instruments
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The proper position of the orchestra instruments is important for the sound performance. To optimize the distribution of orchestra instruments, we propose a mathematical model of sound pressure attenuation. To better optimize the orchestra instrument distribution. The algorithm takes the sound pressure attenuation and the air absorption coefficient into account. In addition, we develop a system to test its performance. By choosing the instruments and the sound pressure level inputted by the user and the sound pressure attenuation equation, the optimal distance of the mike from each instrument can be calculated automatically. By doing so, the best distribution plan can be attained.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Mining Visualization Centralized Control System Based on Neural Network and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Accelerating the iterative upgrade of mine intelligent equipment provides strong technical support for the construction of smart mines, and at the same time, safe production forces mining enterprises to carry out the construction of smart mines. Due to the limitation of underground geological conditions and the nonlinear characteristics of surrounding environment, the parameters to be monitored on each working face are quite complicated and isolated from each other. The traditional data processing method has great limitations, and the quantitative model will make it difficult to determine parameters, reduce system performance and coordinate. Focusing on the establishment of multi-source data model of mining business and the correlation of model data, this paper constructs an intelligent monitoring model based on genetic algorithm (GA) optimized neural network, and studies the visual application effect of centralized control platform on mining production data with the help of digital twin visual integration technology. The simulation results show that the algorithm in this paper has remarkable prediction ability, good real-time performance, powerful learning function and high accuracy. The proposed intelligent mining visualization model can monitor various mine parameters, realize real-time graphic visualization, scene and real-time interaction of mine data, and improve the management level and work efficiency of mining enterprises.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Power Grid Load Management System Based on Artificial Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Smart grid comprehensively monitors the power load of power users through information interaction with power customers and the implementation of time-of-use price, and advocates the use of smart home appliances and the vigorous development of energy storage equipment, encouraging distributed green energy to generate electricity online, which is conducive to the in-depth development of power demand side management, stabilizing power grid load, improving power generation efficiency, reducing energy consumption and protecting the environment. In this paper, based on ANN (Artificial Neural Network) algorithm, a smart grid load management system is constructed. Power load management system, as an important technical means to implement power demand side management, not only supports the successful implementation of orderly power consumption measures in China. The research results show that the forecasting effect of this system is still good as a whole, and it can be found that the actual load is close to the predicted load through experimental comparison. At the same time, the error value is small. Based on ANN algorithm, this paper realizes the purpose of safe and economic operation of smart grid, and its importance has attracted more and more attention from the national government, power enterprises and power users.

articleTitle: Research on Transmission and Distribution Cooperative Control Technology Based on ant Colony Algorithm and Energy Demand Side Response Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent years, the scale of wind power grid connection is growing, and the frequency control problem after wind power grid connection has become a research hotspot. The wind turbine generator unit has decoupling operation characteristics, so it does not have frequency regulation capability. Traditional frequency modulation mainly depends on conventional units and energy storage systems. With the goal of minimizing the total travel time of the road network and considering the balance of the road network flow, a collaborative model of urban traffic control and guidance is established. Based on the in-depth study and analysis of the current integrated energy system and power demand side response, and aiming at the problem that the traditional demand side response can not meet the requirements of the application of integrated energy system in the thermal system description, a joint optimal dispatching model of power, gas and heat integrated energy system with the participation of the user side is proposed. Therefore, this paper introduces the idea of ant colony algorithm, and uses this algorithm to solve the model to get the best path and the best signal timing scheme. Finally, a small road network is used for simulation test. Compared with the actual traffic flow, it shows that this method can effectively balance the road network flow and save the total travel time of the road network.

articleTitle: Simulation of Verification Model of DC Charging Pile for Electric Vehicle Based on Grey Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of China’s electric vehicle industry, electric vehicle charging piles and other infrastructure are also developing rapidly. As a terminal device for charging new energy electric vehicles, DC charging pile is equivalent to a fuel dispenser in a gas station. As the infrastructure of electric vehicle energy supply, the construction scale of charging pile system should complement the number of electric vehicles. Moreover, the intelligent charging of electric vehicle charging pile system will further promote China’s automobile industry to enter the electrification era. The new standard adds several safety detection circuits and communication messages, which improves the safety and reliability of users using electric vehicle charging piles. At the same time, the size of the electric vehicle charging pile interface is further standardized. The unified interface size makes it possible for electric vehicles to use different types of charging piles. In this paper, by analyzing the current situation of the high-power DC energy meter verification device and combining the characteristics of the on-site verification itself, a high-voltage and high-current DC energy meter verification device based on high-speed mixed signal ISPFLASH microcontroller C8051F064 is designed and implemented. The calibration device is composed of standard voltage source, standard current source, standard electric energy meter and controller.

articleTitle: Distributed Energy Storage Coordination Scheduling Algorithm Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: As a classical knowledge representation and reasoning method in the field of artificial intelligence, rule engine has been widely studied and used in academia and industry. In recent years, the popularity of cloud big data provides a broader application space for rule engine, but it also brings severe challenges. Distributed storage is an excellent solution at present. It will realize the following features: scalability, availability, persistence, consistency and partition tolerance. Studies the economic optimal scheduling of distributed energy storage (DES) by formulating a reasonable coordinated scheduling strategy of DES. In this context, the public security work has faced many new challenges. Strengthening the construction of public security information. Based on the existing new energy power generation technology, this paper explores the method of “taking local materials” for power generation, transmission and consumption in rural areas and harsh environment areas where power transmission is difficult to reach. This paper focuses on the solar photovoltaic power generation, wind power generation and biomass power generation technologies which are more mature in new energy technologies, and simulates their power generation and grid connection.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of a Class of Fractional-Order Controllers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In this paper, two types of fractional order systems are given. Taking fractional calculus as the basic tool, the analysis of fractional order systems, the identification of fractional order systems, the design of fractional order controllers and the rational approximation of fractional order operators are carried out and researched. The main work includes the stability and relative stability analysis of two types of fractional-order systems. Due to the introduction of fractional-order calculus operators, the dynamic characteristics of fractional-order systems are much more complicated than those of integer-order systems. The systems are also very different.

articleTitle: Distributed Transaction Performance and Consistency Enhancements Based on Percolator
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet and computer technology, the volume of data and user scale in web applications has been experiencing explosive growth. Due to this massive data, the storage and transaction processing demands cannot be met by traditional relational databases. Therefore, the focus of this paper is on the research of distributed transactions based on the Percolator distributed transaction model in conjunction with TiDB. To address transactional performance, an in-memory lock table mechanism and a crash recovery strategy are proposed to reduce transaction processing latency. In terms of transactional consistency, the S-Percolator protocol is introduced, which is based on read-write conflict detection, ensuring the serializability of transaction scheduling sequences. Through experimental results, the effectiveness of these improvements in TiDB is demonstrated, with reduced database transaction processing latency and the achievement of a serializable isolation level of concurrency control.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability and Fault Soft Self-healing of distribution network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: Power grid system is an important pillar of economic growth and social development. It is an extremely complex and huge artificial system engineering. In order to explore the differences in reliability evaluation within the power grid, the initial topology diagram is first created from the distribution of power stations. Secondly, since the changes of internal and external factors of the power grid over time and space have an impact on the stability of the power grid, the influence degree of the changes of each factor over time and space on the stability is calculated based on the characteristics of the topological network information model. Therefore, the continuous space-time topology network model is established to explore the stability weight of each node and branch. Finally, based on the actual failure rate, power shortage expectation and other reliability indicators, we use the least cut set algorithm to establish the grid reliability model, and select a power system in East China to analyze its reliability differences. In order to explore the fault differences and detect their differences, the spatio-temporal topology network model was first established to study the fault differences. Secondly, the causes of faults were considered, the particle swarm optimization algorithm was used to calculate the number of failures, and the time factors and environmental factors were analyzed. And the correlation between environmental and temporal factors; Finally, the fault detection model is established, and the difference of fault detection is carried out according to the actual case.

articleTitle: Improved 3D Point Clouds Data Registration Based on Second-order Oscillation Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: The traditional Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm is easy to fall into local optimum because of point cloud registration, and swarm intelligence optimization algorithm can effectively solve this problem. However, this will also give rise to a large amount of calculation and low search efficiency. The second-order oscillation artificial bee colony algorithm, feeding a uniformly sampled point cloud data, and extracting a simplified point cloud data based on the domain’s Intrinsic Shape Signature (ISS) radius constraint, was proposed in the 3D point cloud data registration. Simultaneously, the spatial transformation matrix parameters were then acquired through the improved second-order oscillation artificial bee colony algorithm to complete a better initial 3D point cloud data registration. Finally, the nearest neighbor search method (k-Dimension tree, k-d tree) was applied to accelerate the corresponding point search to increase ICP fine registration efficiency. The verification results show that this paper’s algorithm has superior noise resistance, higher registration accuracy, and strong robustness than the traditional registration method through the registration experiment of the point cloud library model and scene data at different initial positions.

articleTitle: Research on Urban Expansion Based on Remote Sensing and Analysis of its Driving Forces-Taking Qingdao as an Example
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous promotion of urbanization, urban expansion has become one of the hot spots of research at home and abroad. The study of urban expansion using satellite remote sensing images has become a hot topic in current remote sensing application research, which can not only provide a rapid and in-depth understanding of the laws and influencing factors of urban expansion, but also provide scientific decision support for urban planning and sustainable development. This paper takes Qingdao city as the research area, selects satellite remote sensing images in 2010, 2015 and 2020. The pre-processed multi-band remote sensing images are supervised and classified by the maximum likelihood method to obtain the land use types in the study area, and then combined with thematic information and multiparty data analysis to explore the changes of urban spatial expansion in Qingdao, and to study the urban land use changes and the main driving factors behind them. The results show that (1) during the period of 2010-2020, the urban scale of Qingdao city has been expanding, and the occupation of arable land and the continuous expansion of construction land have become the main characteristics of land use type changes in Qingdao city during this study period. (2) The urban expansion of Qingdao is influenced by the main driving factors such as policy regulation, population growth and economic development, while the natural environment, transportation facilities and the promotion of tourism industry are also important driving factors.

articleTitle: Simulation Optimization of Narrow-band Internet of Things Coverage Category Updating Based on Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Power, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Control (PEEEC)
abstract: NB-IOT (Narrow-Band Internet of Things) is a large-scale low-power wide-area technology proposed by 3GPP, which is mainly used in application scenarios aimed at data acquisition and sensing. With the rapid development of IOT technology and the connection of things in mobile communication, the traditional communication technology can no longer meet the growing needs of users in terms of cost, flexibility and coverage. When the coverage radius of NB-IOT base station is large or NB-IOT terminals are deployed in channels with unsatisfactory working environment, the same coverage category of all terminals will lead to a sharp decline in terminal performance. Based on this, this paper studies the optimization strategy of NB-IOT coverage category updating, and proposes an IOT gateway load balancing algorithm based on ACO (Ant colony optimization) algorithm, which introduces the residual energy, load and layer value of sensor nodes into the heuristic factors of ACO algorithm, and then the ant colony can choose a data transmission link with higher residual energy and less load when looking for a path, thus obtaining a more balanced data transmission network.
